            let dy = (end[1] - start[1]).abs();
            if dx < 1e-6 && dy > 1e-6 && start[0] <= x_max {

                let high = start[1].max(end[1]);

                    .entry(format!("{:.3}", start[0]))

            } else if dy < 1e-6 && dx > 1e-6 && start[1] >= y_min && start[1] <= y_max {

/// and crosses it is listed only when its own middle is inside.
fn reference_band(corpus: &std::path::Path, name: &str, from: f64, y: (f64, f64)) {
    let Ok(bytes) = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{name}.pdf"))) else {
        println!("  {name}: no reference plot");
        return;

        println!("  {name}: unreadable");
        return;

    let mut rows: Vec<(f64, [f64; 2], [f64; 2])> = Vec::new();

    }
    rows.sort_by(|left, right| right.0.total_cmp(&left.0));
    println!(

=== NEW PROBE ===
//! Which of our 45° hydraulic tick strokes the reference actually has, and what
//! the reference inks where we stamp one it does not.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run -p pid-plot --example probe_which_ticks_the_reference_has -- "<ours.pdf>" "<reference.pdf>"
//! cargo run -p pid-plot --example probe_which_ticks_the_reference_has -- \
//!     "<ours.pdf>" "<reference.pdf>" window <x_mm> <y_mm> [radius_mm]
//! ```
//!
//! Read-only. A complex dash stamps a two-slash glyph once per fitted cell; the
//! glyph's slashes are 3.592 mm at 45° in the page's frame (the run's own
//! direction rotates them, so a vertical run's pair prints at 135°). Pairing
//! our slashes with the reference's by midpoint answers the one question the
//! residual raises: is a charged slash ours alone, or the same slash placed a
//! little differently? `window` then prints both sides' strokes near one place,
//! which is how the charged place's rail-vs-glyph answer is read.
//!
//! The pairing accepts both diagonals: the 45° filter alone would report a
//! vertical run's glyph as missing when the reference draws it at 135°
//! (`docs/analysis/2026-10-26-the-hydraulic-glyph-comes-off-sub-half-period-stubs.md`).

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::read::read_plot;

type Stroke = ([f64; 2], [f64; 2]);

fn len(s: &Stroke) -> f64 {
    ((s.1[0] - s.0[0]).powi(2) + (s.1[1] - s.0[1]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

/// The stroke's direction in [0, 180): a slash reads the same either way round.
fn angle(s: &Stroke) -> f64 {
    ((s.1[1] - s.0[1]).atan2(s.1[0] - s.0[0]).to_degrees() + 180.0) % 180.0
}

fn mid(s: &Stroke) -> [f64; 2] {
    [(s.0[0] + s.1[0]) / 2.0, (s.0[1] + s.1[1]) / 2.0]
}

fn dist(a: [f64; 2], b: [f64; 2]) -> f64 {
    ((a[0] - b[0]).powi(2) + (a[1] - b[1]).powi(2)).sqrt()
}

/// The glyph's slashes on one page: 3.0–4.2 mm, on either diagonal.
fn glyph_slashes(strokes: &[Stroke]) -> Vec<Stroke> {
    strokes
        .iter()
        .filter(|s| (3.0..=4.2).contains(&len(s)))
        .filter(|s| {
            let a = angle(s);
            (a - 45.0).abs() <= 6.0 || (a - 135.0).abs() <= 6.0
        })
        .copied()
        .collect()
}

fn main() {
    let a: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
    let read = |p: &str| {
        let ink = read_plot(&std::fs::read(PathBuf::from(p)).unwrap()).unwrap();
        ink.segments
            .iter()
            .map(|s| (s.start_mm, s.end_mm))
            .collect::<Vec<Stroke>>()
    };
    let ours = read(&a[0]);
    let reference = read(&a[1]);

    if a.get(2).map(String::as_str) == Some("window") {
        let cx: f64 = a[3].parse().expect("x_mm");
        let cy: f64 = a[4].parse().expect("y_mm");
        let r: f64 = a.get(5).map_or(8.0, |v| v.parse().expect("radius_mm"));
        for (tag, strokes) in [("OURS", &ours), ("REF ", &reference)] {
            let mut rows: Vec<(f64, Stroke)> = strokes
                .iter()
                .map(|s| (dist(mid(s), [cx, cy]), *s))
                .filter(|(d, _)| *d <= r)
                .collect();
            rows.sort_by(|l, r| l.0.total_cmp(&r.0));
            println!(
                "== {tag} {} strokes within {r} mm of ({cx},{cy})",
                rows.len()
            );
            for (d, s) in rows {
                println!(
                    "  d {d:7.3}  ({:8.3},{:8.3}) -> ({:8.3},{:8.3})  len {:6.3}  ang {:6.1}",
                    s.0[0],
                    s.0[1],
                    s.1[0],
                    s.1[1],
                    len(&s),
                    angle(&s)
                );
            }
        }
        return;
    }

    let ours_slashes = glyph_slashes(&ours);
    let ref_slashes = glyph_slashes(&reference);
    println!(
        "ours {} strokes, {} slashes; reference {} strokes, {} slashes",
        ours.len(),
        ours_slashes.len(),
        reference.len(),
        ref_slashes.len()
    );
    let mut paired = 0;
    let mut alone: Vec<(f64, Stroke)> = Vec::new();
    for t in &ours_slashes {
        let d = ref_slashes
            .iter()
            .map(|r| dist(mid(t), mid(r)))
            .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
        if d <= 0.6 {
            paired += 1;
        } else {
            alone.push((d, *t));
        }
    }
    println!("ours paired with a reference slash within 0.6 mm: {paired}");
    alone.sort_by(|l, r| r.0.total_cmp(&l.0));
    println!("ours with no reference slash ({}):", alone.len());
    for (d, t) in &alone {
        let m = mid(t);
        let nearest =
            reference
                .iter()
                .map(|r| (dist(m, mid(r)), *r))
                .fold(
                    (f64::INFINITY, *t),
                    |best, c| {
                        if c.0 < best.0 { c } else { best }
                    },
                );
        println!(
            "  ours ({:7.3},{:7.3}) -> ({:7.3},{:7.3})  len {:5.3} ang {:5.1}  nearest reference \
             slash {d:6.3} mm; nearest reference stroke {:.3} mm len {:.3} ang {:.1}",
            t.0[0],
            t.0[1],
            t.1[0],
            t.1[1],
            len(t),
            angle(t),
            nearest.0,
            len(&nearest.1),
            angle(&nearest.1)
        );
    }
}

/// that pairs with a longer stroke is not a missing glyph, it is the same

/// it is the distance to that stroke next to the distance to a slash.
fn report(tag: &str, slashes: &[Stroke], other: &[Stroke], other_slashes: &[Stroke]) {
    let mut paired = 0;
    let mut alone: Vec<(f64, Stroke)> = Vec::new();
    for s in slashes {
        let d = other_slashes
            .iter()
            .map(|o| dist(mid(s), mid(o)))
            .fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);

    alone.sort_by(|l, r| r.0.total_cmp(&l.0));
    println!("{tag} with no such slash ({}):", alone.len());

        let nearest = other
            .iter()
            .map(|o| (dist(m, mid(o)), *o))
            .fold((f64::INFINITY, *s), |best, c| {

            });
        println!(
            "  {tag} ({:7.3},{:7.3}) -> ({:7.3},{:7.3})  len {:5.3} ang {:5.1}  nearest other \
             slash {d:6.3} mm; nearest other stroke {:.3} mm len {:.3} ang {:.1}",
            s.0[0], s.0[1], s.1[0], s.1[1], len(s), angle(s), nearest.0, len(&nearest.1), angle(&nearest.1)

//! Where a complex dash stamps its marks along each run, against where the
//! reference plot puts them.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run -p pid-plot --example probe_complex_dash_marks -- <drawing.pid> <reference.pdf>
//! ```
//!
//! A `JStyleSimpleDashType` in its complex form stamps a glyph once per fitted
//! cell of its advance; `model::stamp_complex_dash` owns that layout. This probe
//! reads the glyph back off the reference plot — a 3–4 mm 45° stroke is a mark,
//! its pair is the glyph — and prints, per run, the run's length, the cell count
//! three candidate rules give, and the mark centres the reference inks.
//!
//! The `our centres` line reports where the current layout stamps: one per
//! fitted cell, centred in it, except that a run fitting a single glyph keeps
//! the pattern's own advance and puts that glyph half a period in.
//!
//! The two walls of a pipe carry the same glyph, and either wall's marks fall
//! within a few millimetres of the other's line; the `side` filter keeps a run's
//! own marks only (the glyph half-width is 1.8 mm, so the neighbouring wall sits
//! ~3.8 mm out).

use std::path::Path;

use pid_parse::style_link::line_styles_for_document;
use pid_parse::{PidGraphicKind, PidParser, build_normalized_geometry};
use pid_plot::read::read_plot;

type Stroke = ([f64; 2], [f64; 2]);

fn length(a: [f64; 2], b: [f64; 2]) -> f64 {
    (b[0] - a[0]).hypot(b[1] - a[1])
}

/// Signed distance of `point` from the line through `a` and `b`, positive on the
/// left of `a -> b`.
fn side(point: [f64; 2], a: [f64; 2], b: [f64; 2]) -> f64 {
    let (dx, dy) = (b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]);
    let square = dx * dx + dy * dy;
    if square <= 1e-12 {
        return 0.0;
    }

            && (t - last).abs() > 2.2
        {
            out.push(group.iter().sum::<f64>() / group.len() as f64);
            group.clear();
        }
        group.push(t);

## 一、差额出在带的两个边上，不在几何上

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),
        PathBuf::from,
    )

/// Where the shelled-out plant backup sits, if this machine has one.
///
/// The extraction is a local artifact, not a repository fixture, so the gate
/// looks beside the corpus and then in the backup package itself. `None`
/// soft-skips the test, which is what CI sees.
fn backup_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let mut roots = Vec::new();
    if let Some(dir) = std::env::var_os("PID_TEST_DATA_DIR") {
        roots.push(PathBuf::from(dir));
    }
    roots.push(corpus_dir());
    roots.push(PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\pid-test-data"));
    roots.push(PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\plant-code\cad\pid-test-data"));
    roots
        .into_iter()
        .map(|root| root.join("backup-plant-data"))
        .find(|candidate| candidate.is_dir())
}

fn collect_pids(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.filter_map(Result::ok).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
    paths.sort();
    for path in paths {
        if path.is_dir() {
            collect_pids(&path, out);
        } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "pid") {
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
}

{"kind":"tool","id":"eUTSD8EZ0s0","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"examples/probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link.rs","instructions":"Add a probe that reports, per .pid, the declared page size, frame state and whether an .igr template is linked.","content":"//! Does an A2 sheet link a border template — and if so, what is it called?
//!
//! `2026-10-23-the-border-template-draws-the-sheet-furniture.md` resolves a
//! sheet's furniture by extent: every `.igr` under the corpus's template
//! directories is parsed and the one whose stroked extent *is* the page is the
//! template ([`pid_plot::model`]). The corpus ships `CPE-SQ-A0.igr` and
//! `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` only, so every A2 sheet in the plant backup draws no
//! furniture at all.
//!
//! Two different findings wear the same outward face, and this probe separates
//! them:
//!
//! * the sheet links an `.igr` this machine does not have — then the missing
//!   file has a name, and the fix is to obtain it; or
//! * no `.igr` is linked at all — then the sheet was authored without a frame,
//!   drawing none is correct, and nothing is missing.
//!
//! The link record is the only evidence either way: the drawing's own geometry
//! carries no furniture (that is why the template is needed), and the page size
//! alone cannot tell a framed A2 from an unframed one.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run --example probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link -- <a.pid|dir> [more ...]
//! ```

use pid_parse::{ParseOptions, PidParser};
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

fn collect_pids(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.filter_map(Result::ok).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
    paths.sort();
    for path in paths {
        if path.is_dir() {
            collect_pids(&path, out);
        } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "pid") {
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    for arg in std::env::args().skip(1) {
        let path = PathBuf::from(&arg);
        if path.is_dir() {
            collect_pids(&path, &mut files);
        } else {
            files.push(path);
        }
    }
    if files.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("usage: probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link <a.pid|dir> [more ...]");
        return;
    }

    let mut igr_linked = 0usize;
    let mut igr_unlinked = 0usize;
    let mut no_page = 0usize;
    for path in &files {
        let doc = match PidParser::with_options(ParseOptions::geometry()).parse_file(path) {
            Ok(doc) => doc,
            Err(error) => {
                println!("{}\n  parse failed: {error}", path.display());
                continue;
            }
        };
        let page = doc
            .sheet_streams
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|s| s.geometry.as_ref())
            .find_map(|g| g.page_dimensions_mm);
        let frames: Vec<String> = doc
            .sheet_streams
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|s| s.geometry.as_ref())
            .flat_map(|g| g.decoded_igsmartframes.iter())
            .map(|frame| {
                format!(
                    "state={:?} {:.2}x{:.2}mm",
                    frame.state,
                    frame.extent_width_m * 1000.0,
                    frame.extent_height_m * 1000.0
                )
            })
            .collect();
        // Every OLE link the document states, `igr` or not: a sheet that links
        // some *other* kind of object is a different reading than a bare one.
        let mut links: Vec<&str> = doc
            .jsites
            .iter()
            .flat_map(|site| site.ole_links.iter())
            .map(String::as_str)
            .collect();
        links.sort_unstable();
        links.dedup();
        let igr: Vec<&str> = links
            .iter()
            .copied()
            .filter(|link| link.to_lowercase().contains(".igr"))
            .collect();

        let sheet = match page {
            Some((width, height)) => {
                let (short, long) = if width <= height {
                    (width, height)
                } else {
                    (height, width)
                };
                match (short.round() as i64, long.round() as i64) {
                    (594, 841) => "A1",
                    (841, 1189) => "A0",
                    (420, 594) => "A2",
                    (297, 420) => "A3",
                    _ => "other",
                }
            }
            None => "no page",
        };
        match (page, igr.is_empty()) {
            (None, _) => no_page += 1,
            (Some(_), false) => igr_linked += 1,
            (Some(_), true) => igr_unlinked += 1,
        }
        let name = path
            .file_name()
            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        println!(
            "{sheet:<4} page={:<16} frames=[{}] igr={:?} links={linkcount}  {name}",
            page.map_or("none".to_string(), |(w, h)| format!("{w:.2}x{h:.2}")),
            frames.join("; "),
            igr,
            linkcount = links.len(),
        );
    }

    println!(
        "\n{} files: {igr_linked} link an .igr, {igr_unlinked} link none, {no_page} declare no page",
        files.len()
    );
}
"}}

D:\work\plant-code\cad\pid-parse\test-file\Ref\Template Files\{CPE-SQ-A0.igr,CPE-SQ-A1.igr}

而图纸侧的 `\001Ole` 流写着它们指向谁。53 张整厂备份里 45 张至少链一个 `.igr`，名字落在
**四族**里；语料五张与 `test-file` 七张另有第三、第四族：

| 链的名字 | 族 / 幅面 | 用了它的图（备份） | 磁盘上有吗 |
|---|---|---:|---|

| `CPE-SQ~3.IGR` | CPE-SQ / A0（1189.00 × 841.00） | 8 | ✅ `CPE-SQ-A0.igr` |
| `CPE-SQ~1.IGR` | CPE-SQ / A2（594.00 × 420.00） | **7** | ❌ **缺** |
| `\CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr`（与 `CPECCH~2.IGR` 同现） | CPECCHB / A2（594.33 × 420.57） | **9** | ❌ **缺** |

## 三、挂上的判据：现成的规则，一行代码都不用改

`pid-plot/src/model.rs` 的 `load_border_template` 逐份解析模板目录下的 `.igr`，用
`ink_extent_mm` 量它的描边范围，取 **`max(|Δw|, |Δh|) ≤ 2 mm`**（`TEMPLATE_EXTENT_TOLERANCE_MM`）
里误差最小的那一份，**不做任何缩放**。所以拿到文件后要满足的只有一件事：**它的框就是它自己的
范围**。

- 第 1 份：7 张的页幅恰好 `594.00 × 420.00`；同族的 `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` 画的是 `(0,0)–(841,594)`
  且与 B 的页幅误差 0.00 mm。A2 同法出图就是 **0.00 mm** → 直接命中。
- 第 2 份：9 张的页幅是 `594.33 × 420.57`；同族的 A1 兄弟在 `O井场` / `P井场` 上是
  `841.15 × 594.40`（同样带 `+0.15 / +0.40` 那半格）→ 只要 A2 那份同法出图，误差 **0.00 mm**。

放置位置是模板搜索目录里的第一个：**`<语料>/Ref/Template Files/`**（备份与语料用同一个），
仓库内的夹具放 `test-file/Ref/Template Files/`。两份都放进去之后：

```text
cargo run -p pid-plot --example probe_page_defects -- <备份目录>   # template 计数 31 → 47
```

**明确不做的**：把 `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` 按 594/841 缩放成 A2。图框与标题栏的线宽、格子尺寸、
字高都是作者按纸面毫米定的，整体缩放会把它们一并改小；`2026-10-23` 那轮已经写明宁可「不画家
具，也不从别一档缩放上猜」。同理，用 A1 的家具挪坐标自己拼一份 A2 模板也是猜 —— 拼出来的
东西没有参考出图可对，不该进产品。

## 四、核查顺带查出来的三件事

### 4.1 判据是**族盲**的：5 张现在穿着别族的家具

页幅落在 2 mm 窗口里就会被认成那张纸的模板，哪怕图纸链的是别的族：

| 图 | 页幅 | 链的是 | 实际画的是 | 证据 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `O井场`、`P井场` | 841.15 × 594.40 | `CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr` | `CPE-SQ-A1.igr`（误差 0.40） | `probe_page_defects`：`dup … furniture=true`、`SimSun:34` |
| `集注站 凝析油稳定塔、泵及换热器(600td)` | 842.54 × 595.54 | 无 `.igr` 链 | `CPE-SQ-A1.igr`（误差 1.54） | 同上 |
| `A井场` | 1189.31 × 841.31 | 一个非 `.igr` 的 OLE 对象 | `CPE-SQ-A0.igr`（误差 0.31） | 同上 |
| `test-file/工艺管道及仪表流程-1.pid` | 841.00 × 594.00 | `XA-A1.igr` | `CPE-SQ-A1.igr`（误差 **0.00**） | 同上（该图 34 条 `SimSun` 正是模板的 34 条标签） |

模板的 34 条标签全是 `SimSun`，所以「这张纸有没有家具」在 `probe_page_defects` 的字体列上
直接可读：7 张 CPE-SQ A2 那张（`A井场进站生产收球筒`）字表里没有 `SimSun`、也没有
`furniture=true` 的重复项 —— **它确实一条家具都没画**。

这 5 张现在都没有参考出图，判定不了「该不该穿别族的家具」。这是**既有的口径**，不是本轮的
回归；只是现在有名有姓，能选了。

### 4.2 `A01` 的 Embedded 帧里没有内容：仓库内没有 A2 夹具

`test-file/export-test/publish-data/A01/A01.pid` 的帧态是 `Embedded / LocallyLinked`，
Embedded 那一条声明 `594.00 × 420.00`（正是 A2）—— 按 `igOLEEmbedded` 的定义「被框的对象
存在本图里」，它本该自带一份 A2 家具。查了：

- `probe_ole_links`：6 个 `JSite`，**没有一个**带 `\001Ole` 流或链；
- `pid_inspect --coverage`：顶层流只有 `JSite*` / `PSM*` / `StyleCluster` / `TaggedTxt*` /
  `DocVersion*` / 两张 `SummaryInformation`，没有 `\001Ole` / `\001CompObj` 一类。

所以那份家具的字节不在文件里（帧只声明了幅面）。**结论：仓库内没有一份 A2 家具可以当夹具**，
A2 这条路要落地必须先有 §2 的文件，或者拿一张 A2 的参考出图反推。

### 4.3 四张没有页幅声明的图

`D井场`、`换热器CD`、`凝析油一级闪蒸分离器B气相出口改造`、`Q井场` 的
`page_dimensions_mm` 是 `None`，模板这一步整块跳过。其中 `Q井场` 的两条帧记录互相矛盾：

- 一条 `Linked 841.15 × 594.40`（A1 幅面），
- 一条 `Embedded 689.60 × 554.30`，
- 链的是 `CPECCH~3.IGR`（按族里 `~3` 用在 A0 页上推，是 A0）。

幅面、链名、帧范围三个数彼此打架，**先不动**：这张图要先有人能说清它画多大。

## 五、可选的口径改动（要不要做由人定）

`load_border_template` 现在只按范围认文件。改成**先按链接名找、找不到再按范围**，可以做到：

- 长名（`CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr`、`CPECHBA2.igr`、`XA-A1.igr`、`XIONGANA2.igr`）直接当键；
- 只有短名时抽出**族前缀**（`CPE-SQ` / `CPECCH` / `XA` / `XIONGAN`），把范围匹配限制在该族内；
- 该族在磁盘上没有对应幅面的文件时，**不画**，而不是拿别族的顶。

代价是 §4.1 那 5 张会**失去**现在身上那件别族家具。那 5 张没有参考出图，所以这次改动等于把
一个「可能是对的错」换成「确定的不画」。**建议**：等 §2 的文件到位、并且有一张 A2 参考出图
之后一起做，那时才有判定「该画什么」的依据。本轮只把它写成选项。

## 六、拿到之后怎么验

```text
# 1) 放进 Ref/Template Files/ 后，先量模板自己
cargo run --example probe_igr_template -- "<语料>/Ref/Template Files"
#    同族应长得像 A0/A1：≈173 图元（Line 104 / Polyline 17 / Arc 18 / Text 34），
#    范围恰是 (0,0)–(594,420)

# 2) 谁挂上了：31 张 → 47 张
cargo run -p pid-plot --example probe_page_defects -- <备份目录>

# 3) 重钉三条闸门
cargo test -p pid-plot --test export_plant_backup -- --nocapture
cargo test -p pid-plot --test border_template     -- --nocapture
cargo test -p pid-plot --test export_every_fixture -- --nocapture
```

三条闸门里要改的钉子是明确的：

- `export_plant_backup` 现在钉 53 张的模板计数与一堆下界读数；涨到 47 之后按新数重钉，
  并确认没有别的数字（图元、文字、重复项）被家具带偏 —— 家具会新增 ≈ 173 图元 + 34 标签/张。
- `border_template` 现在有两支：A1（`B` 夹具）与 A0（`I井场`）逐字对照模板，外加一支
  「没有匹配模板的 A2（`D06`）不画家具」。第 2 份文件到位后**最后那一支要反过来**：
  `D06` 应画出 CCHB 的家具，且它的两条框线与 34 条标签要逐条对得上（那时才有第一份 A2 证据）。
- 五张参考图（`plot_compare`）里没有 A2，读数不受影响；`write_five_drawings` 同理。

## 七、复现

```text
cargo run --example probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link -- <a.pid|dir> ...
cargo run --example probe_ole_links -- <a.pid>
cargo run --bin pid_inspect -- <a.pid> --coverage
find "<语料>" "<备份>" -iname "*.igr"
```

`probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link` 的输出每行是
`幅面页幅 帧态与范围 igr=[链到的名字] 文件名`，末行给三类计数；本页所有「谁链了什么」都是它
一次跑完 53 张的读数。

+# A2 图框模板：缺的是哪几份、拿到之后怎么挂上（2026-10-27 核查）
+
+`docs/analysis/2026-10-23-the-border-template-draws-the-sheet-furniture.md` 定下「模板按
+**描边范围 = 页幅**认」这条规则，当时记的是「A2 的图纸在这套语料里没有对应模板，所以不画
+家具」。本轮把这句话查到底：**磁盘上确实一份 A2 模板都没有**，但**图纸自己把它们的名字写在
+链路记录里** —— 所以这不是「不知道缺什么」，而是「知道缺什么、只要拿到就能挂上」。
+
+核查由 `probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link`（本轮新增）做：它逐张打印声明的页幅、
+图框记录的三态与范围，以及 `igOLELinked` 那只 `JSite` 的 `\001Ole` moniker 列表。
+
+## 一、磁盘上没有 A2 模板，但名字在记录里
+
+整棵可达目录树里只有两份 `.igr`，是同一份内容的两个副本：
+
+```text
+D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证\Ref\Template Files\{CPE-SQ-A0.igr,CPE-SQ-A1.igr}
+D:\work\plant-code\cad\pid-parse\test-file\Ref\Template Files\{CPE-SQ-A0.igr,CPE-SQ-A1.igr}
+```
+
+而图纸侧的 `\001Ole` 流写着它们指向谁。53 张整厂备份里 45 张至少链一个 `.igr`，名字落在
+**四族**里；语料五张与 `test-file` 七张另有第三、第四族：
+
+| 链的名字 | 族 / 幅面 | 用了它的图（备份） | 磁盘上有吗 |
+|---|---|---:|---|
+| `CPE-SQ~2.IGR` | CPE-SQ / A1（841.00 × 594.00） | 20 | ✅ `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` |
+| `CPE-SQ~3.IGR` | CPE-SQ / A0（1189.00 × 841.00） | 8 | ✅ `CPE-SQ-A0.igr` |
+| `CPE-SQ~1.IGR` | CPE-SQ / A2（594.00 × 420.00） | **7** | ❌ **缺** |
+| `\CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr`（与 `CPECCH~2.IGR` 同现） | CPECCHB / A2（594.33 × 420.57） | **9** | ❌ **缺** |
+| `Ref\Template Files\CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr`（与 `CPECCH~3.IGR` 同现） | CPECCHB / A1（841.15 × 594.40） | 2（`O井场`、`P井场`） | ❌ 缺（现由 CPE-SQ 的 A1 顶替，见 §4.1） |
+| 没有 `.igr` 链 | — | 4（`A井场`、`N井场`、`1200td`、`600td`） | — |
+| 没有页幅 | — | 4（`D井场`、`换热器CD`、`凝析油…B气相出口改造`、`Q井场`） | — |
+
+`~1` / `~2` / `~3` 是 **DOS 8.3 的碰撞序号**（同目录同名文件按建入次序编号），不是幅面代码：
+同一族里 `~3` 出现在 A0 页上、`~2` 出现在 A1 页上、`~1` 出现在 A2 页上，只是这族文件的建入
+次序恰好是从大到小。所以**幅面的证据是页幅本身**，文件名按该族自己的命名法推：
+`CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr` 这个名字是记录里明写的长名，`CPE-SQ-A2.igr` 是照同族 `-A0` / `-A1` 补的。
+
+## 二、要拿的东西（清单）
+
+| # | 文件名（请求用） | 一句话说明 | 影响 |
+|---|---|---|---|
+| 1 | `CPE-SQ-A2.igr` | 与我们已有的 A0 / A1 同一族，A2 幅面 | 备份 **7 张**（`集注站 进出站收发球单元 A/B/C/E/G/J/L井场进站生产收球筒…`，页幅恰好 594.00 × 420.00） |
+| 2 | `CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr` | 另一族（华北分公司版），记录里长名明写 | 备份 **9 张**（`00/02` 三张改造图 + `test/U01` 的 `D01`、`D03`、`D04`、`D06`、`D07`、`TESTDWG-0002TP03-01`，页幅 594.33 × 420.57）；`test-file/D06.pid` 同一份 |
+| 3 | `CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr` | 第 2 份的 A1 兄弟 | 备份 2 张（`O井场`、`P井场`，页幅 841.15 × 594.40） |
+| 4 | `XA-A1.igr`（`\SPID\XaLNG\P&ID Reference Data\Template Files\`） | 熊安项目的 A1 | `test-file/工艺管道及仪表流程-1.pid`（841.00 × 594.00） |
+| 5 | `CPECCHBA2.igr`（无连字符） | 第三种拼法 | `test-file/DWG-0202GP06-01.pid`（593.75 × 419.63，仓库内两份副本） |
+| 6 | `XIONGANA2.igr` | 熊安项目的 A2 | `test-file/DWG-0201GP06-01.pid`（594.31 × 420.31） |
+| 7 | `CPECCH` 的 A0（记录里只有短名 `CPECCH~3.IGR`） | 待定 | `Q井场` 链它，但这张图**没有声明页幅**，先不动（见 §4.3） |
+
+第 1、2 份落定，`53` 张里的挂模板数从 **31 → 47**。第 3 份**不动这个计数**：`O井场`、`P井场` 现在就在画家具（穿的是 CPE-SQ 的 A1），它改的是那两张「画对了没有」。
+
+## 三、挂上的判据：现成的规则，一行代码都不用改
+
+`pid-plot/src/model.rs` 的 `load_border_template` 逐份解析模板目录下的 `.igr`，用
+`ink_extent_mm` 量它的描边范围，取 **`max(|Δw|, |Δh|) ≤ 2 mm`**（`TEMPLATE_EXTENT_TOLERANCE_MM`）
+里误差最小的那一份，**不做任何缩放**。所以拿到文件后要满足的只有一件事：**它的框就是它自己的
+范围**。
+
+- 第 1 份：7 张的页幅恰好 `594.00 × 420.00`；同族的 `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` 画的是 `(0,0)–(841,594)`
+  且与 B 的页幅误差 0.00 mm。A2 同法出图就是 **0.00 mm** → 直接命中。
+- 第 2 份：9 张的页幅是 `594.33 × 420.57`；同族的 A1 兄弟在 `O井场` / `P井场` 上是
+  `841.15 × 594.40`（同样带 `+0.15 / +0.40` 那半格）→ 只要 A2 那份同法出图，误差 **0.00 mm**。
+
+放置位置是模板搜索目录里的第一个：**`<语料>/Ref/Template Files/`**（备份与语料用同一个），
+仓库内的夹具放 `test-file/Ref/Template Files/`。两份都放进去之后：
+
+```text
+cargo run -p pid-plot --example probe_page_defects -- <备份目录>   # template 计数 31 → 47
+```
+
+**明确不做的**：把 `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` 按 594/841 缩放成 A2。图框与标题栏的线宽、格子尺寸、
+字高都是作者按纸面毫米定的，整体缩放会把它们一并改小；`2026-10-23` 那轮已经写明宁可「不画家
+具，也不从别一档缩放上猜」。同理，用 A1 的家具挪坐标自己拼一份 A2 模板也是猜 —— 拼出来的
+东西没有参考出图可对，不该进产品。
+
+## 四、核查顺带查出来的三件事
+
+### 4.1 判据是**族盲**的：5 张现在穿着别族的家具
+
+页幅落在 2 mm 窗口里就会被认成那张纸的模板，哪怕图纸链的是别的族：
+
+| 图 | 页幅 | 链的是 | 实际画的是 | 证据 |
+|---|---|---|---|---|
+| `O井场`、`P井场` | 841.15 × 594.40 | `CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr` | `CPE-SQ-A1.igr`（误差 0.40） | `probe_page_defects`：`dup … furniture=true`、`SimSun:34` |
+| `集注站 凝析油稳定塔、泵及换热器(600td)` | 842.54 × 595.54 | 无 `.igr` 链 | `CPE-SQ-A1.igr`（误差 1.54） | 同上 |
+| `A井场` | 1189.31 × 841.31 | 一个非 `.igr` 的 OLE 对象 | `CPE-SQ-A0.igr`（误差 0.31） | 同上 |
+| `test-file/工艺管道及仪表流程-1.pid` | 841.00 × 594.00 | `XA-A1.igr` | `CPE-SQ-A1.igr`（误差 **0.00**） | 同上（该图 34 条 `SimSun` 正是模板的 34 条标签） |
+
+模板的 34 条标签全是 `SimSun`，所以「这张纸有没有家具」在 `probe_page_defects` 的字体列上
+直接可读：7 张 CPE-SQ A2 那张（`A井场进站生产收球筒`）字表里没有 `SimSun`、也没有
+`furniture=true` 的重复项 —— **它确实一条家具都没画**。
+
+这 5 张现在都没有参考出图，判定不了「该不该穿别族的家具」。这是**既有的口径**，不是本轮的
+回归；只是现在有名有姓，能选了。
+
+### 4.2 `A01` 的 Embedded 帧里没有内容：仓库内没有 A2 夹具
+
+`test-file/export-test/publish-data/A01/A01.pid` 的帧态是 `Embedded / LocallyLinked`，
+Embedded 那一条声明 `594.00 × 420.00`（正是 A2）—— 按 `igOLEEmbedded` 的定义「被框的对象
+存在本图里」，它本该自带一份 A2 家具。查了：
+
+- `probe_ole_links`：6 个 `JSite`，**没有一个**带 `\001Ole` 流或链；
+- `pid_inspect --coverage`：顶层流只有 `JSite*` / `PSM*` / `StyleCluster` / `TaggedTxt*` /
+  `DocVersion*` / 两张 `SummaryInformation`，没有 `\001Ole` / `\001CompObj` 一类。
+
+所以那份家具的字节不在文件里（帧只声明了幅面）。**结论：仓库内没有一份 A2 家具可以当夹具**，
+A2 这条路要落地必须先有 §2 的文件，或者拿一张 A2 的参考出图反推。
+
+### 4.3 四张没有页幅声明的图
+
+`D井场`、`换热器CD`、`凝析油一级闪蒸分离器B气相出口改造`、`Q井场` 的
+`page_dimensions_mm` 是 `None`，模板这一步整块跳过。其中 `Q井场` 的两条帧记录互相矛盾：
+
+- 一条 `Linked 841.15 × 594.40`（A1 幅面），
+- 一条 `Embedded 689.60 × 554.30`，
+- 链的是 `CPECCH~3.IGR`（按族里 `~3` 用在 A0 页上推，是 A0）。
+
+幅面、链名、帧范围三个数彼此打架，**先不动**：这张图要先有人能说清它画多大。
+
+## 五、可选的口径改动（要不要做由人定）
+
+`load_border_template` 现在只按范围认文件。改成**先按链接名找、找不到再按范围**，可以做到：

+//! Does an A2 sheet link a border template — and if so, what is it called?
+//!
+//! `2026-10-23-the-border-template-draws-the-sheet-furniture.md` resolves a
+//! sheet's furniture by extent: every `.igr` under the corpus's template
+//! directories is parsed and the one whose stroked extent *is* the page is the
+//! template ([`pid_plot::model`]). The corpus ships `CPE-SQ-A0.igr` and
+//! `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` only, so every A2 sheet in the plant backup draws no
+//! furniture at all.
+//!
+//! Two different findings wear the same outward face, and this probe separates
+//! them:
+//!
+//! * the sheet links an `.igr` this machine does not have — then the missing
+//!   file has a name, and the fix is to obtain it; or
+//! * no `.igr` is linked at all — then the sheet was authored without a frame,
+//!   drawing none is correct, and nothing is missing.
+//!
+//! The link record is the only evidence either way: the drawing's own geometry
+//! carries no furniture (that is why the template is needed), and the page size
+//! alone cannot tell a framed A2 from an unframed one.
+//!
+//! ```text
+//! cargo run --example probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link -- <a.pid|dir> [more ...]
+//! ```
+
+use pid_parse::{build_normalized_geometry, ParseOptions, PidParser};
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+fn collect_pids(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
+    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
+        return;
+    };
+    let mut paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.filter_map(Result::ok).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
+    paths.sort();
+    for path in paths {
+        if path.is_dir() {
+            collect_pids(&path, out);
+        } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "pid") {
+            out.push(path);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn main() {
+    let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
+    for arg in std::env::args().skip(1) {
+        let path = PathBuf::from(&arg);
+        if path.is_dir() {
+            collect_pids(&path, &mut files);
+        } else {
+            files.push(path);
+        }
+    }
+    if files.is_empty() {
+        eprintln!("usage: probe_which_template_the_a2_sheets_link <a.pid|dir> [more ...]");
+        return;
+    }
+
+    let mut igr_linked = 0usize;
+    let mut igr_unlinked = 0usize;
+    let mut no_page = 0usize;
+    for path in &files {
+        let doc = match PidParser::with_options(ParseOptions::geometry()).parse_file(path) {
+            Ok(doc) => doc,
+            Err(error) => {
+                println!("{}\n  parse failed: {error}", path.display());
+                continue;
+            }
+        };
+        let page = build_normalized_geometry(&doc).page_dimensions_mm;
+        let frames: Vec<String> = doc
+            .sheet_streams
+            .iter()
+            .filter_map(|s| s.geometry.as_ref())
+            .flat_map(|g| g.decoded_igsmartframes.iter())
+            .map(|frame| {
+                format!(
+                    "state={:?} {:.2}x{:.2}mm",
+                    frame.state,
+                    frame.extent_width_m * 1000.0,
+                    frame.extent_height_m * 1000.0
+                )
+            })
+            .collect();
+        // Every OLE link the document states, `igr` or not: a sheet that links
+        // some *other* kind of object is a different reading than a bare one.
+        let mut links: Vec<&str> = doc
+            .jsites
+            .iter()
+            .flat_map(|site| site.ole_links.iter())
+            .map(String::as_str)
+            .collect();
+        links.sort_unstable();
+        links.dedup();
+        let igr: Vec<&str> = links
+            .iter()
+            .copied()
+            .filter(|link| link.to_lowercase().contains(".igr"))
+            .collect();
+
+        let sheet = match page {
+            Some((width, height)) => {
+                let (short, long) = if width <= height {
+                    (width, height)
+                } else {
+                    (height, width)
+                };
+                match (short.round() as i64, long.round() as i64) {
+                    (594, 841) => "A1",
+                    (841, 1189) => "A0",
+                    (420, 594) => "A2",
+                    (297, 420) => "A3",
+                    _ => "other",
+                }
+            }
+            None => "no page",
+        };
+        match (page, igr.is_empty()) {
+            (None, _) => no_page += 1,
+            (Some(_), false) => igr_linked += 1,
+            (Some(_), true) => igr_unlinked += 1,
+        }
+        let name = path
+            .file_name()
+            .map(|n| n.to_string_lossy().to_string())
+            .unwrap_or_default();
+        println!(
+            "{sheet:<4} page={:<16} frames=[{}] igr={:?} links={linkcount}  {name}",
+            page.map_or("none".to_string(), |(w, h)| format!("{w:.2}x{h:.2}")),
+            frames.join("; "),
+            igr,
+            linkcount = links.len(),
+        );
+    }
+
+    println!(
+        "\n{} files: {igr_linked} link an .igr, {igr_unlinked} link none, {no_page} declare no page",
+        files.len()
+    );

//! Write one `.pid` drawing to a PDF.

use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::process::ExitCode;

use pid_plot::fonts::{font_dirs, prepare_fonts};
use pid_plot::model::lay_out_drawing;
use pid_plot::write::{PlotFont, write_plot};

fn main() -> ExitCode {
    let mut args = env::args().skip(1);
    let Some(pid) = args.next() else {
        eprintln!("usage: pid_plot <drawing.pid> <out.pdf> [corpus]");
        eprintln!("typefaces come from PID_PLOT_FONTS, then <corpus>/fonts");
        return ExitCode::from(2);
    };
    let Some(out) = args.next() else {
        eprintln!("usage: pid_plot <drawing.pid> <out.pdf> [corpus]");
        return ExitCode::from(2);
    };
    let corpus = args.next().map_or_else(default_corpus, PathBuf::from);
    let model = match lay_out_drawing(PathBuf::from(&pid).as_path(), &corpus) {
        Ok(model) => model,
        Err(error) => {
            eprintln!("{pid}: {error}");
            return ExitCode::from(1);
        }
    };
    let mut prepared = match prepare_fonts(&[&model], &font_dirs(Some(&corpus))) {
        Ok(faces) => faces,
        Err(error) => {
            eprintln!("{pid}: {error}");
            return ExitCode::from(1);
        }
    };
    if let Ok(path) = env::var("PID_PLOT_CJK_FONT") {
        match fs::read(&path) {
            Ok(bytes) => prepared.push(pid_plot::fonts::PreparedFont {
                key: String::new(),
                bytes,
            }),
            Err(error) => {
                eprintln!("read {path}: {error}");
                return ExitCode::from(1);
            }
        }
    }
    let fonts: Vec<PlotFont<'_>> = prepared
        .iter()
        .map(|face| PlotFont {
            key: &face.key,
            bytes: &face.bytes,
        })
        .collect();
    let pdf = match write_plot(&model, &fonts) {
        Ok(pdf) => pdf,
        Err(error) => {
            eprintln!("{pid}: {error}");
            return ExitCode::from(1);
        }
    };
    if let Some(parent) = PathBuf::from(&out).parent()
        && !parent.as_os_str().is_empty()
        && let Err(error) = fs::create_dir_all(parent)
    {
        eprintln!("mkdir {}: {error}", parent.display());
        return ExitCode::from(1);
    }
    if let Err(error) = fs::write(&out, &pdf) {
        eprintln!("write {out}: {error}");
        return ExitCode::from(1);
    }
    // The page actually written. A drawing that states none is measured, and
    // this is the number the PDF carries — reporting nothing here would say
    // `0.00 0.00` about a page that was plotted on real paper.
    let page = model.resolved_page_mm().unwrap_or([0.0, 0.0]);
    println!(
        "primitives {} segments_written_page_mm {:.2} {:.2} bytes {}",
        model.primitives.len(),
        page[0],
        page[1],
        pdf.len()
    );
    ExitCode::SUCCESS
}

fn default_corpus() -> PathBuf {
    env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),
        PathBuf::from,
    )
}

/// The file name a stored path ends in, for a one-line placement report.
fn leaf_name(path: &str) -> &str {
    path.rsplit(['\\', '/']).next().unwrap_or(path)
}

fn main() {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let mut files: Vec<PathBuf> = Vec::new();
    for arg in std::env::args().skip(1) {
        let path = PathBuf::from(&arg);
        if path.is_dir() {
            collect_pids(&path, &mut files);
        } else {
            files.push(path);
        }
    }
    if files.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("usage: probe_which_template_each_sheet_wore <a.pid|dir> [more ...]");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }

    let mut templated = 0usize;
    let mut placements = 0usize;
    for path in &files {
        let name = path
            .file_name()
            .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().to_string())
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let model = match lay_out_drawing(path, &corpus) {
            Ok(model) => model,
            Err(error) => {
                println!("ERR  {error}  {name}");
                continue;
            }
        };
        let page = model.resolved_page_mm().unwrap_or([0.0, 0.0]);
        let Some(template) = model.template.as_ref() else {
            println!("none {page:8.2} x {:<8.2} {name}", page[1]);
            continue;
        };
        templated += 1;
        println!(
            "TMPL {page:8.2} x {:<8.2} {} -> {} extent {:.2} x {:.2} primitives {}",
            page[1],
            name,
            leaf_name(&template.path),
            template.extent_mm[0],
            template.extent_mm[1],
            template.primitives
        );
        for symbol in &template.symbols {
            placements += 1;
            println!(
                "       places {:?} at ({:.3}, {:.3}) mm from {:?}, library {} ({:?}), ink {:?}",
                leaf_name(&symbol.key),
                symbol.insertion_mm[0],
                symbol.insertion_mm[1],
                symbol.body,
                symbol.library_available,
                symbol.name_gap,
                symbol.extent_mm
            );
        }
    }
    println!(
        "\n{} files: {templated} wore a template, {placements} placements",
        files.len()
    );
}

fix(pid-plot): read a glyph's marks by its own arms, not a length band

The page that retired the sub-half-period clamp left one thing open: I's
44 slashes against the reference's 60, and the 16 that would have had to
show up in the uncovered column if they were missing glyphs. They are not
glyphs, and no reference ink is missing.

The surplus is the pairing probe's own 3.0-4.2 mm band. This package inks
a stroke 0.8-2.6% longer than the reference does the same stroke, and both
band edges sit on a glyph length, so each side's spelling is admitted on
one edge and cut on the other: the reference's 2.996 mm strokes are 4 um
below the 3.0 edge while our 3.021 mm copies are inside it, and our
4.245 mm strokes are 45 um above the 4.2 edge while the reference's
4.192 mm copies are inside. All 22 unpaired reference strokes turned out
to have a stroke of ours 0.010-0.156 mm away, of the same length and
angle. The band now clears both spellings (2.8-4.4) and the probe reports
both directions, plus the nearest other stroke next to each unpaired one,
since a "missing" slash with an equal-length stroke 0.1 mm away is one
stroke cut at a crossing. I then reads 97 against 94 with 93 paired each
way, L 99/90, CD 57/41, A 47/36, B 37/29, and the few that remain
unpaired are the same artefact at the new edges.

I's glyph is not a diagonal at all, which is the larger half of why that
sheet's counts never matched: its complex dash stamps an L of two 2.540 mm
arms, one along the run and one across it. The 45/135 degree proxy was
measuring other geometry there (symbol-body diagonals at 4.19/4.245 mm),
never marks.

probe_complex_dash_marks had the same weakness from the other side: its
length band only kept the CD sheets' wall strokes out by 0.033 mm (the
wall measures 4.233 against a glyph slash of 3.61), so widening it to see
I's glyph also read those walls as marks, and the band narrow enough to
hold the CD sheets read no mark of I's at all. It now asks the glyph the
run actually carries: the arms are rotated out of the glyph's own frame
(+x along the run -- the CD pair reads (2.5, 2.6) mm locally and prints at
135 degrees on a vertical run, not 46) and a reference stroke is an arm
when it is within 8 degrees of one and 0.7-1.3 times its length, the
window being shorter than the arm because the reader cuts a stroke where
another line crosses it. The CD readings are unchanged (6.19 -> 5.08,
28.13 -> 4.62/14.02/23.42, 34.60 -> 5.81/17.41/28.92), both stubs read
bare again, and I's marks all appear: 8 for our 8 on the 63.41 mm runs,

0.047 and 0.050 mm from the reference's, its rail 63.412 against 63.331.

centre 3.04, glyph origin about 3.69, ours 3.81) -- the same half-advance
boundary the last round locked, read now from a second glyph and a second

fn attr(start: &quick_xml::events::BytesStart<'_>, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    start.attributes().flatten().find_map(|attribute| {
        if attribute.key.as_ref() == key {
            attribute
                .normalized_value(quick_xml::XmlVersion::Implicit1_0)
                .ok()
                .map(std::borrow::Cow::into_owned)
        } else {
            None
        }
    })
}

pub(crate) fn decode_zip_name(raw: &[u8]) -> String {
    if let Ok(utf8) = std::str::from_utf8(raw) {
        return utf8.to_string();
    }
    let (decoded, _, had_errors) = encoding_rs::GBK.decode(raw);
    if had_errors {
        raw.iter().map(|byte| format!("{byte:02x}")).collect()
    } else {
        decoded.into_owned()
    }
}

fn publish_guid(raw: &str) -> String {
    let trimmed = raw.trim();
    if let Some(rest) = trimmed.strip_prefix('@') {
        return format!("@{rest}");
    }
    if trimmed.starts_with('{') {
        format!("@{trimmed}")
    } else {
        format!("@{{{trimmed}}}")
    }
}

## 做了什么

新增 [src/refdata_archive.rs](src/refdata_archive.rs) 与一个新特性 `refdata-archive`（就是 `zip` 依赖本身，`default-features = false` + `deflate`）。三个入口：`refdata_archives(dir)` 找目录里的 `RefData*.zip`、`archive_members(archive, "igr"|"sym")` 按扩展名列成员（只走中央目录、不解压）、`read_archive_member(archive, name)` 取字节；成员用 `ArchiveFile` 表示，`label()` 给出 `<zip 路径>\<成员名>` 这样的路径。`backup-exp` 改为经由这个特性启用 `dep:zip`，而 [pid-plot/Cargo.toml](pid-plot/Cargo.toml) 只骑这一个特性 —— 所以「画一张图」不链接 publish 管线、rusqlite 或仓库里的 GPL MDF 解析器。

两个坑都在名字上：`RefData~4~682.zip` 里**每个**条目名都带 UTF-8 BOM（目录条目也是 `\u{feff}Assemblies/`），不归一的话 `Path::file_name` / `ends_with` / `file_stem` 全部对不上；名字还可能 GBK，所以取成员一律按索引遍历、与归一化名比较，**不用** `ZipArchive::by_name`（它按 `zip` crate 自己的解码匹配，遇 GBK 会拒）。既有的 `decode_zip_name` 从 `backup::datamap` 移进本模块，两处共用一份。

接入点两处，都遵循「目录先、归档后」：

- **符号库** [src/symbol_library.rs](src/symbol_library.rs)：`SymbolLibrary::with_archives(…)` 把归档当成一种根，排在**所有**目录根之后 —— 于是解出与否不改变任何一张图的读数；按名索引（标题栏那种无盘符的绝对路径）也把归档成员建进去，「唯一」判据因此跨目录与归档同样成立。`read_symbol_geometry_from_bytes`（`PidPackage::from_bytes`，不落临时文件）是同一份 `.sym` 解码的字节入口，`read_symbol_geometry` 变成它的外壳。
- **模板** [pid-plot/src/model.rs](pid-plot/src/model.rs)：`TemplateSource::{File, Member}` + `refdata_archive_files(corpus)`（语料目录，然后它的父目录）。成员以 `ArchiveFile::label()` 参与判据，所以 `ends_with`、`file_stem`、链名前缀、误差量化一行都不用改。

fix(pid-plot): pick a sheet's template by the link it names, then its extent
The checklist that closed the last round sent this one looking for three
border templates on other machines. They were in the backup's own
RefData~4~682.zip, exactly where the corpus keeps its symbol library, so
extracting them into Ref/Template Files was expected to do one thing:
give furniture to the sixteen sheets that had none. It did that and, with
it, took furniture away from twenty.

CPE-SQ-A1.igr and CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr are both authored for A1 and both
stroke to 841.0000 x 594.0000 mm; they part in the last bits of their f64
metres, 841.0000000000001 against 841.0000000003785. A page states
841.0000500894253, so which one is nearer the sheet is decided by that
noise -- 3.8e-10 mm, two orders below an atom's width. The extent-only
pick read it, so the twenty A1 sheets that link CPE-SQ~2.IGR wore
another family's A1, and since CPECCHB-SQ-A1 places no symbol at all, the
proportional-scale wave those sheets had drawn a round earlier vanished
with them. border_template's A1 case caught it by name.

The tie is broken by evidence the sheet states itself. A link record
spells an authoring-machine path, usually through Windows' 8.3 name
(CPE-SQ~2.IGR for CPE-SQ-A1.igr), and the stem of the last component is a
prefix of the file it names -- CPE-SQ is not a prefix of CPECCHB-SQ-A1,
which is what makes it decisive where the extent is not. linked_template_
prefix cuts only the file name at the '~' (the '~' in TEMPLA~1 is a
directory's), and template_rank orders the candidates: named by the sheet
first, then the extent error quantized to 1e-3 mm, then the name on disk.
Quantizing is what makes the third key reachable -- a page linking
nothing, 600td, is 1.54 mm off both A1 templates and differs between them
by the same 3.8e-10, so it used to swing with the float and now answers
CPE-SQ-A1 twice. A micrometre is 150x finer than the closest two
templates of different sizes come, so nothing measurable is given up.

Readings: 47 of the backup's 53 sheets wear a template, up from 31, and
they place 63 symbols. Per template: CPE-SQ-A1 21 (20 linking CPE-SQ~2
plus 600td on extent), CPE-SQ-A0 8, CPE-SQ-A2 7, CPECCHB-SQ-A2 9,
CPECCHB-SQ-A1 2 -- the last two the sheets the checklist named.

What a template places is not one symbol per sheet, which the old
placements == templated equality asserted: CPECCHB-SQ-A1 places none (its
title block has no 比例 cell) and CPECCHB-SQ-A2 places three, the wave
under another authoring machine's temp name plus the two sign-off cells'
HQZ.sym. That equality held of the two templates the corpus had, so the
export gate now pins each template's placement list by file name and
panics on a template no pin covers. All 63 placements read from the
template's own cache and all 63 have a name gap.

Two questions the count could not answer are settled in passing. D06.pid
links \CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr, so border_template's "an A2 sheet with no
matching template draws none" case rests on the corpus lacking that file,
not on the sheet lacking a frame -- it will draw once the file is a
fixture, and that is when the first per-line A2 comparison becomes
possible. And the template loader reads directories only, never the
RefData zips, so exporting a backup package directory still sees no
templates at all; that step stays manual.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_parse::api::PidParser;
use pid_parse::build_normalized_geometry;
use pid_parse::style_link::{line_styles_for_document, style_names_for_document};

fn main() {
    let Some(arg) = std::env::args().nth(1) else {
        eprintln!("usage: tmp_wide_pen_styles <a.pid>");
        return;
    };
    let doc = PidParser::new()
        .parse_file(PathBuf::from(&arg))
        .expect("parse");
    let styles = line_styles_for_document(&doc);
    let names = style_names_for_document(&doc);
    let geometry = build_normalized_geometry(&doc);

    // How many entities each style actually paints, so a style nothing uses is
    // told apart from one that draws half a page.
    let mut users: BTreeMap<(String, u32), usize> = BTreeMap::new();
    let mut symbols: BTreeMap<(String, u32), String> = BTreeMap::new();
    for entity in &geometry.entities {
        let (Some(stream), Some(oid)) = (entity.source.stream_path.clone(), entity.graphic_oid) else {
            continue;
        };
        *users.entry((stream.clone(), oid)).or_default() += 1;
        if !entity.symbol.is_empty() {
            symbols.insert((stream, oid), entity.symbol.clone());
        }
    }

    println!("{} entities, {} resolved line styles", geometry.entities.len(), styles.len());
    let mut wide = 0usize;
    for ((stream, oid), style) in &styles {
        let width = style.symbology.width_mm();
        if width < 1.0 {
            continue;
        }
        wide += 1;
        let name = names
            .get(&(stream.clone(), style.style_id))
            .map_or("-", String::as_str);
        let painted = users.get(&(stream.clone(), *oid)).copied().unwrap_or(0);
        let symbol = symbols
            .get(&(stream.clone(), *oid))
            .map_or("-", String::as_str);
        println!(
            "{width:8.3} mm  style {} {name:?}  {} oid {oid}  entities {painted}  symbol {symbol}  dash {}  colour {:?}",
            style.style_id,
            stream.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or(stream),
            u8::from(style.dash.is_some()),
            style.symbology.rgb()
        );
    }
    if wide == 0 {
        println!("no style declares 1 mm or more");
    }
    // Names of every style at all, so the wide one can be compared with its
    // neighbours by name rather than only by number.
    let mut by_name: BTreeMap<&str, usize> = BTreeMap::new();
    for style in styles.values() {
        *by_name.entry("all").or_default() += 1;
    }
}

{"kind":"tool","id":"e78zkWKsEDM","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"examples/probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen.rs","instructions":"Promote the wide-pen scratch probe into a named probe that prints each drawing's style table by width.","content":"//! Which style a drawing's widest pens belong to, by name.
//!
//! A page's pen is its entity's `JStyleSimpleLine` width, and the style table
//! also holds entries that are not pens at all: `SmartPlant` writes its
//! validation marks there (`BandAid`, `lsOk`, `lsWarning`) with the mark's own
//! on-screen size — `BandAid` states 10 mm, fifteen times the widest drafting
//! width in this corpus. Asking a page which style paints an outlier width is
//! what tells a pen from a mark.
//!
//! ```text
//! cargo run --example probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen -- <a.pid> [more ...]
//! ```
//!
//! Per drawing: the entity count, then one row per style wide to thin —
//! `width  style <id>  <name>  rgb  entities` — so a style the drawing never
//! paints is absent and one that paints half the page is unmistakable.

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_parse::api::PidParser;
use pid_parse::build_normalized_geometry;
use pid_parse::style_link::{line_styles_for_document, style_names_for_document};

fn main() {
    let paths: Vec<PathBuf> = std::env::args().skip(1).map(PathBuf::from).collect();
    if paths.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("usage: probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen <a.pid> [more ...]");
        std::process::exit(2);
    }
    for path in &paths {
        let name = path.file_stem().map_or_else(
            || path.display().to_string(),
            |stem| stem.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
        );
        let doc = match PidParser::new().parse_file(path) {
            Ok(doc) => doc,
            Err(error) => {
                println!("FAIL {name}: {error}");
                continue;
            }
        };
        let styles = line_styles_for_document(&doc);
        let names = style_names_for_document(&doc);
        let geometry = build_normalized_geometry(&doc);

        // How many entities each resolved style actually paints, so a style
        // nothing uses is told apart from one that draws half a page.
        let mut users: BTreeMap<(String, u32), usize> = BTreeMap::new();
        for entity in &geometry.entities {
            let (Some(stream), Some(oid)) = (entity.source.stream_path.clone(), entity.graphic_oid)
            else {
                continue;
            };
            *users.entry((stream, oid)).or_default() += 1;
        }

        // One row per (width, name, colour): the table's own shape, not one row
        // per record that names a style.
        let mut table: BTreeMap<(i64, String, [u8; 3]), (u32, usize)> = BTreeMap::new();
        for ((stream, oid), style) in &styles {
            let style_name = names
                .get(&(stream.clone(), style.style_id))
                .cloned()
                .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into());
            let painted = users.get(&(stream.clone(), *oid)).copied().unwrap_or(0);
            let key = (
                (style.symbology.width_mm() * 1000.0).round() as i64,
                style_name,
                style.symbology.rgb(),
            );
            let entry = table.entry(key).or_insert((style.style_id, 0));
            entry.1 += painted;
        }
        println!(
            "{name}: {} entities, {} resolved line styles",
            geometry.entities.len(),
            styles.len()
        );
        for ((thousandths, style_name, rgb), (style_id, painted)) in table.iter().rev() {
            println!(
                "  {:8.3} mm  style {style_id:4}  {style_name:<28} rgb {rgb:?}  entities {painted}",
                *thousandths as f64 / 1000.0
            );
        }
    }
}

{"kind":"tool","id":"e7_t7XdxT18","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"docs/analysis/2026-10-27-a-validation-band-is-not-a-pen.md","content":"# 一条 10 mm 的笔宽：那是 `BandAid` 校验带，不是笔（2026-10-27）

上一轮整包出图时，`Q井场` 的笔宽直方图里有一条谁都解释不了的读数：

```text
pens [0.130:180 0.180:844 0.350:2423 0.700:271 10.000:9 default:636]
```

53 张图里最宽的正经笔是 0.70 mm（个别模板体内 0.8），而这一张有 **9 条 10.000 mm**。
一条 10 mm 的线画在 594 mm 高的纸上，等于把一段 3.8 × 7.6 mm 的阀门本体涂成黑块。本轮把这
9 条查到底：它们不是解码错，而是**图纸自己的样式表里的一条校验标记**，被当成了笔。

## 一、落点：一个放置，一条样式，一个实体

`probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen`（本轮新增）按笔宽列出图纸的样式表：

```text
Q井场 注采阀组工艺及自控流程图: 3974 entities, 2746 resolved line styles
   10.000 mm  style   92  BandAid                      rgb [255, 167, 119]  entities 1
    0.700 mm  style   63  Primary Piping - New         rgb [128, 128, 0]  entities 280
    0.350 mm  style   64  Secondary Piping - New       rgb [128, 128, 0]  entities 51
    0.350 mm  style    1  Normal                       rgb [0, 0, 0]  entities 539
    …
```

- 宽笔只有 `style 92` 一条，**只画 1 个实体**。
- 那个实体是 `2 Way Globe Type 3.sym` 的一个放置：`Sheet6` oid 5620，插入点
  (269.11, 362.92) mm，旋转 90°；解析后的样式名就叫 `BandAid`，色 `[255,167,119]`（鲑色）。
- 同一个样式表里还有 `style 61 "lsOk"`（0.1 mm，黑）与 `style 81 "lsWarning"`（0.1 mm，蓝）——
  这正是 `src/style_link.rs` 早就记过的那批状态样式（`ls…` / `ps…` 前缀），
  也就是 `SmartPlant` 的校验引擎写给工程师看、而不是写给绘图机看的那几条。

## 二、不是解错了 `.sym`

第一嫌疑是符号体自己带 10 mm。`dump_symbol_geometry` 直接否掉：那份 `.sym` 的 11 条线全是
`@000000:13`，即 **0.13 mm**。

```text
$ cargo run --example dump_symbol_geometry -- …/2 Way Globe Type 3.sym
line,-0.000851694680083717,-0.00042534711932492984,-0.003809999999999999,-0.0019049999999999998,@000000:13
…（11 条，全部 @000000:13）
```

于是 10 mm 只可能来自放置（placement）那一侧，而 `pid-plot/src/model.rs` 的 `body_stroke`
规则确实是「放置的样式整体重绘符号体：颜色与笔宽都盖过体自己的」。这条规则对普通样式是对的
（`Equipment - New` 0.35 mm 等），对一条**校验标记**就错了：它把一个 0.13 mm 的阀门轮廓
改写成 10 mm。

## 三、为什么纸面上确实错了

`write.rs` 的 `pen_width_mm` 把任何声明宽度压到三支笔上（0.169 / 0.339 / 0.678 mm），所以
10 mm 落到最粗那支 —— 看起来「只是粗了 4 倍」，而不是黑块。但同一张纸上其余阀门都是
0.13 mm → 0.169 mm 的细线，**只有这一个阀门被画成粗线**。这是肉眼可见的偏差，也正是
`BandAid` 不该出现在墨里的原因：屏幕上它是一条蒙在被标记对象上的带子，纸上是对象的轮廓。

## 四、修法：一条「是不是笔」的判据

`pid-plot/src/write.rs` 里加在笔表旁边，而不是散在模型里：

```rust
/// The widest width a drafting pen declares in this corpus, in millimetres.
pub const WIDEST_PEN_MM: f64 = 1.0;

/// Whether a declared width is one a plotter pen can carry.
pub fn carries_a_pen(declared_mm: f64) -> bool { … }
```

理由：这套语料的 ISO 128 笔阶梯最高 0.70 mm，`pen_width_mm` 已把它压到最粗笔；超过 1 mm 的
宽度就不是笔了——`BandAid` 的 10 mm 是那条带子的屏幕宽度，比最粗的正当笔宽 14 倍。1.0 mm 留了
0.7 的余量，同时离 10 mm 足够远。

`body_stroke` 只改**宽度**这一项：放置的宽度要经 `carries_a_pen` 才生效，否则体自己的笔宽
（该 `.sym` 的 0.13 mm）说算；颜色仍随放置（单色笔表反正把它着成黑）。宽度的例外写在函数头
注释里，名字与那条带子一起记下来。

## 五、读数

| | 改前 | 改后 |
|---|---|---|
| `Q井场` 笔宽 | `0.130:180 … 10.000:9` | `0.130:189 …`（10.000 消失，9 条回到 0.13） |
| `Q井场` PDF | 672876 B | 672868 B |
| 整包 53 张 | — | 47 张挂框 / 63 放置 / 63 有名字缺口，读数不变 |

新闸门断言（`pid-plot/tests/export_plant_backup.rs`）：**任何图纸自己的墨都不会用比最宽笔更宽的
宽度**（`!primitive.furniture` 范围内的 `stroke.width_mm <= WIDEST_PEN_MM`）。挂框页的
「家具」不在范围内——模板的笔是模板自己的。

## 六、复现

```text
# 谁在画宽笔（按图纸列样式表，宽到细）
cargo run --example probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen -- <Q井场.pid>

# 符号体自己的笔宽（证明 10 mm 不是体里的）
cargo run --example dump_symbol_geometry -- "…/Ref/Symbols/Instrumentation/In-Line/Valves/2 Way Common/2 Way Globe Type 3.sym"

# 判据与规则的单元测试
cargo test -p pid-plot --lib carries_a_pen
cargo test -p pid-plot --lib a_placement_pen

# 整包闸门（含新断言）
cargo test -p pid-plot --test export_plant_backup -- --nocapture
```

## 七、边界

- 修的是**符号体上的笔宽**，不是「把带标记的对象丢掉」：对象照画，只是用它自己的笔。
- `BandAid` 的颜色仍进模型（`rgb [255,167,119]`），因为对象的样式确实写着它；单色笔表把它着成
  黑，所以纸面无差别。若哪一轮要「校验标记一律不上纸」，那是另一个问题，本节没答。
- 判据是「比最宽笔宽就是标记」，不是「名字叫 `BandAid` 就是标记」：名字会随项目/语言变，宽度
  阶梯不会。53 张里唯一越过 1 mm 的样式就是这一条，而每条正经笔宽都 ≤0.70 mm。
"}}

+# 一条 10 mm 的笔宽：那是 `BandAid` 校验带，不是笔（2026-10-27）
+
+上一轮整包出图时，`Q井场` 的笔宽直方图里有一条谁都解释不了的读数：
+
+```text
+pens [0.130:180 0.180:844 0.350:2423 0.700:271 10.000:9 default:636]
+```
+
+53 张图里最宽的正经笔是 0.70 mm（个别模板体内 0.8），而这一张有 **9 条 10.000 mm**。
+一条 10 mm 的线画在 594 mm 高的纸上，等于把一段 3.8 × 7.6 mm 的阀门本体涂成黑块。本轮把这
+9 条查到底：它们不是解码错，而是**图纸自己的样式表里的一条校验标记**，被当成了笔。
+
+## 一、落点：一个放置，一条样式，一个实体
+
+`probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen`（本轮新增）按笔宽列出图纸的样式表：
+
+```text
+Q井场 注采阀组工艺及自控流程图: 3974 entities, 2746 resolved line styles
+   10.000 mm  style   92  BandAid                      rgb [255, 167, 119]  entities 1
+    0.700 mm  style   63  Primary Piping - New         rgb [128, 128, 0]  entities 280
+    0.350 mm  style   64  Secondary Piping - New       rgb [128, 128, 0]  entities 51
+    0.350 mm  style    1  Normal                       rgb [0, 0, 0]  entities 539
+    …
+```
+
+- 宽笔只有 `style 92` 一条，**只画 1 个实体**。
+- 那个实体是 `2 Way Globe Type 3.sym` 的一个放置：`Sheet6` oid 5620，插入点
+  (269.11, 362.92) mm，旋转 90°；解析后的样式名就叫 `BandAid`，色 `[255,167,119]`（鲑色）。
+- 同一个样式表里还有 `style 61 "lsOk"`（0.1 mm，黑）与 `style 81 "lsWarning"`（0.1 mm，蓝）——
+  这正是 `src/style_link.rs` 早就记过的那批状态样式（`ls…` / `ps…` 前缀），
+  也就是 `SmartPlant` 的校验引擎写给工程师看、而不是写给绘图机看的那几条。
+
+## 二、不是解错了 `.sym`
+
+第一嫌疑是符号体自己带 10 mm。`dump_symbol_geometry` 直接否掉：那份 `.sym` 的 11 条线全是
+`@000000:13`，即 **0.13 mm**。
+
+```text
+$ cargo run --example dump_symbol_geometry -- …/2 Way Globe Type 3.sym
+line,-0.000851694680083717,-0.00042534711932492984,-0.003809999999999999,-0.0019049999999999998,@000000:13
+…（11 条，全部 @000000:13）
+```
+
+于是 10 mm 只可能来自放置（placement）那一侧，而 `pid-plot/src/model.rs` 的 `body_stroke`
+规则确实是「放置的样式整体重绘符号体：颜色与笔宽都盖过体自己的」。这条规则对普通样式是对的
+（`Equipment - New` 0.35 mm 等），对一条**校验标记**就错了：它把一个 0.13 mm 的阀门轮廓
+改写成 10 mm。
+
+## 三、为什么纸面上确实错了
+
+`write.rs` 的 `pen_width_mm` 把任何声明宽度压到三支笔上（0.169 / 0.339 / 0.678 mm），所以
+10 mm 落到最粗那支 —— 看起来「只是粗了 4 倍」，而不是黑块。但同一张纸上其余阀门都是
+0.13 mm → 0.169 mm 的细线，**只有这一个阀门被画成粗线**。这是肉眼可见的偏差，也正是
+`BandAid` 不该出现在墨里的原因：屏幕上它是一条蒙在被标记对象上的带子，纸上是对象的轮廓。
+
+## 四、修法：一条「是不是笔」的判据
+
+`pid-plot/src/write.rs` 里加在笔表旁边，而不是散在模型里：
+
+```rust
+/// The widest width a drafting pen declares in this corpus, in millimetres.
+pub const WIDEST_PEN_MM: f64 = 1.0;
+
+/// Whether a declared width is one a plotter pen can carry.
+pub fn carries_a_pen(declared_mm: f64) -> bool { … }
+```
+
+理由：这套语料的 ISO 128 笔阶梯最高 0.70 mm，`pen_width_mm` 已把它压到最粗笔；超过 1 mm 的
+宽度就不是笔了——`BandAid` 的 10 mm 是那条带子的屏幕宽度，比最粗的正当笔宽 14 倍。1.0 mm 留了
+0.7 的余量，同时离 10 mm 足够远。
+
+`body_stroke` 只改**宽度**这一项：放置的宽度要经 `carries_a_pen` 才生效，否则体自己的笔宽
+（该 `.sym` 的 0.13 mm）说算；颜色仍随放置（单色笔表反正把它着成黑）。宽度的例外写在函数头
+注释里，名字与那条带子一起记下来。
+
+## 五、读数
+
+| | 改前 | 改后 |
+|---|---|---|
+| `Q井场` 笔宽 | `0.130:180 … 10.000:9` | `0.130:189 …`（10.000 消失，9 条回到 0.13） |
+| `Q井场` PDF | 672876 B | 672868 B |
+| 整包 53 张 | — | 47 张挂框 / 63 放置 / 63 有名字缺口，读数不变 |
+
+新闸门断言（`pid-plot/tests/export_plant_backup.rs`）：**任何图纸自己的墨都不会用比最宽笔更宽的
+宽度**（`!primitive.furniture` 范围内的 `stroke.width_mm <= WIDEST_PEN_MM`）。挂框页的
+「家具」不在范围内——模板的笔是模板自己的。
+
+## 六、复现
+
+```text
+# 谁在画宽笔（按图纸列样式表，宽到细）
+cargo run --example probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen -- <Q井场.pid>
+
+# 符号体自己的笔宽（证明 10 mm 不是体里的）
+cargo run --example dump_symbol_geometry -- "…/Ref/Symbols/Instrumentation/In-Line/Valves/2 Way Common/2 Way Globe Type 3.sym"
+
+# 判据与规则的单元测试
+cargo test -p pid-plot --lib carries_a_pen
+cargo test -p pid-plot --lib a_placement_pen
+
+# 整包闸门（含新断言）
+cargo test -p pid-plot --test export_plant_backup -- --nocapture
+```
+
+## 七、边界
+
+- 修的是**符号体上的笔宽**，不是「把带标记的对象丢掉」：对象照画，只是用它自己的笔。
+- `BandAid` 的颜色仍进模型（`rgb [255,167,119]`），因为对象的样式确实写着它；单色笔表把它着成
+  黑，所以纸面无差别。若哪一轮要「校验标记一律不上纸」，那是另一个问题，本节没答。
+- 判据是「比最宽笔宽就是标记」，不是「名字叫 `BandAid` 就是标记」：名字会随项目/语言变，宽度
+  阶梯不会。53 张里唯一越过 1 mm 的样式就是这一条，而每条正经笔宽都 ≤0.70 mm。

+//! Which style a drawing's widest pens belong to, by name.
+//!
+//! A page's pen is its entity's `JStyleSimpleLine` width, and the style table
+//! also holds entries that are not pens at all: `SmartPlant` writes its
+//! validation marks there (`BandAid`, `lsOk`, `lsWarning`) with the mark's own
+//! on-screen size — `BandAid` states 10 mm, fifteen times the widest drafting
+//! width in this corpus. Asking a page which style paints an outlier width is
+//! what tells a pen from a mark.
+//!
+//! ```text
+//! cargo run --example probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen -- <a.pid> [more ...]
+//! ```
+//!
+//! Per drawing: the entity count, then one row per style wide to thin —
+//! `width  style <id>  <name>  rgb  entities` — so a style the drawing never
+//! paints is absent and one that paints half the page is unmistakable.
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use pid_parse::api::PidParser;
+use pid_parse::build_normalized_geometry;
+use pid_parse::style_link::{line_styles_for_document, style_names_for_document};
+
+fn main() {
+    let paths: Vec<PathBuf> = std::env::args().skip(1).map(PathBuf::from).collect();
+    if paths.is_empty() {
+        eprintln!("usage: probe_which_style_paints_a_wide_pen <a.pid> [more ...]");
+        std::process::exit(2);
+    }
+    for path in &paths {
+        let name = path.file_stem().map_or_else(
+            || path.display().to_string(),
+            |stem| stem.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
+        );
+        let doc = match PidParser::new().parse_file(path) {
+            Ok(doc) => doc,
+            Err(error) => {
+                println!("FAIL {name}: {error}");
+                continue;
+            }
+        };
+        let styles = line_styles_for_document(&doc);
+        let names = style_names_for_document(&doc);
+        let geometry = build_normalized_geometry(&doc);
+
+        // How many entities each resolved style actually paints, so a style
+        // nothing uses is told apart from one that draws half a page.
+        let mut users: BTreeMap<(String, u32), usize> = BTreeMap::new();
+        for entity in &geometry.entities {
+            let (Some(stream), Some(oid)) = (entity.source.stream_path.clone(), entity.graphic_oid)
+            else {
+                continue;
+            };
+            *users.entry((stream, oid)).or_default() += 1;
+        }
+
+        // One row per (width, name, colour): the table's own shape, not one row
+        // per record that names a style.
+        let mut table: BTreeMap<(i64, String, [u8; 3]), (u32, usize)> = BTreeMap::new();
+        for ((stream, oid), style) in &styles {
+            let style_name = names
+                .get(&(stream.clone(), style.style_id))
+                .cloned()
+                .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into());
+            let painted = users.get(&(stream.clone(), *oid)).copied().unwrap_or(0);
+            let key = (
+                (style.symbology.width_mm() * 1000.0).round() as i64,
+                style_name,
+                style.symbology.rgb(),
+            );
+            let entry = table.entry(key).or_insert((style.style_id, 0));
+            entry.1 += painted;
+        }
+        println!(
+            "{name}: {} entities, {} resolved line styles",
+            geometry.entities.len(),
+            styles.len()
+        );
+        for ((thousandths, style_name, rgb), (style_id, painted)) in table.iter().rev() {
+            println!(
+                "  {:8.3} mm  style {style_id:4}  {style_name:<28} rgb {rgb:?}  entities {painted}",
+                *thousandths as f64 / 1000.0
+            );
+        }
+    }
+}

+//! Print every line style a drawing resolves whose width is 1 mm or more, the
+//! style's own name, and how many entities resolve to it.
+//!
+//! Scratch probe (gitignored): asks one drawing where an unusually wide pen on
+//! a page comes from — the drawing's style table, or the symbol body.
+//!
+//! ```text
+//! cargo run --example tmp_wide_pen_styles -- <a.pid>
+//! ```
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use pid_parse::api::PidParser;
+use pid_parse::build_normalized_geometry;
+use pid_parse::style_link::{line_styles_for_document, style_names_for_document};
+
+fn main() {
+    let Some(arg) = std::env::args().nth(1) else {
+        eprintln!("usage: tmp_wide_pen_styles <a.pid>");
+        return;
+    };
+    let doc = PidParser::new()
+        .parse_file(PathBuf::from(&arg))
+        .expect("parse");
+    let styles = line_styles_for_document(&doc);
+    let names = style_names_for_document(&doc);
+    let geometry = build_normalized_geometry(&doc);
+
+    // How many entities each style actually paints, so a style nothing uses is
+    // told apart from one that draws half a page.
+    let mut users: BTreeMap<(String, u32), usize> = BTreeMap::new();
+    let mut kinds: BTreeMap<(String, u32), String> = BTreeMap::new();
+    for entity in &geometry.entities {
+        let (Some(stream), Some(oid)) = (entity.source.stream_path.clone(), entity.graphic_oid) else {
+            continue;
+        };
+        *users.entry((stream.clone(), oid)).or_default() += 1;
+        kinds
+            .entry((stream, oid))
+            .or_insert_with(|| format!("{:?}", entity.kind));
+    }
+
+    println!("{} entities, {} resolved line styles", geometry.entities.len(), styles.len());
+    let mut wide = 0usize;
+    for ((stream, oid), style) in &styles {
+        let width = style.symbology.width_mm();
+        if width < 1.0 && std::env::args().nth(2).is_none() {
+            continue;
+        }
+        wide += 1;
+        let name = names
+            .get(&(stream.clone(), style.style_id))
+            .map_or("-", String::as_str);
+        let painted = users.get(&(stream.clone(), *oid)).copied().unwrap_or(0);
+        let kind = kinds.get(&(stream.clone(), *oid)).map_or("-", String::as_str);
+        println!(
+            "{width:8.3} mm  style {} {name:?}  {} oid {oid}  entities {painted}  kind {kind}  dash {}  colour {:?}",
+            style.style_id,
+            stream.rsplit('/').next().unwrap_or(stream),
+            u8::from(style.dash.is_some()),
+            style.symbology.rgb()
+        );
+    }
+    if wide == 0 {
+        println!("no style declares 1 mm or more");
+    }
+    // The style table itself: every record's name, width and colour, so a
+    // special-purpose entry can be read against the ordinary ones beside it.
+    if std::env::args().nth(2).is_some() {
+        println!("\nstyle table, wide to thin:");
+        let mut table: Vec<(f64, u32, String, [u8; 3], usize)> = Vec::new();
+        for ((stream, oid), style) in &styles {
+            let name = names
+                .get(&(stream.clone(), style.style_id))
+                .cloned()
+                .unwrap_or_else(|| "-".into());
+            let painted = users.get(&(stream.clone(), *oid)).copied().unwrap_or(0);
+            table.push((
+                style.symbology.width_mm(),
+                style.style_id,
+                name,
+                style.symbology.rgb(),
+                painted,
+            ));
+        }
+        table.sort_by(|left, right| {
+            right
+                .0
+                .partial_cmp(&left.0)
+                .unwrap_or(std::cmp::Ordering::Equal)
+                .then(left.1.cmp(&right.1))
+        });
+        table.dedup_by(|left, right| left.0 == right.0 && left.2 == right.2 && left.3 == right.3);
+        for (width, id, name, rgb, painted) in table {
+            println!("{width:8.3} mm  style {id:4}  {name:<28} rgb {rgb:?}  entities {painted}");
+        }
+    }
+}

## 量出来的结果

用备份包当语料（`PID_TEST_DATA_DIR=D:\work\plant-code\cad\pid-test-data`）跑一遍 53 张图的模板归属，语料里的 `.igr` 一共 7 份交互面，正好对应 7 行 pin：

| 模板 | 幅面 | 落位次数 | 放的符号 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` | 841 × 594 | 20 | `blfh.sym` |
| `CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr` | 594 × 420 | 9 | `a$c40d91a4b.sym`, `hqz.sym` ×2 |
| `CPE-SQ-A2.igr` | — | 7 | 已 pin |
| `CPE-SQ-A0.igr` | 1189 × 841 | 7 | `blfh.sym` |
| `CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr` | — | 2 | 已 pin |
| **`A0-W - New.igr`** | 1189 × 841 | 1 | **无（105 个图元，全是标题栏家具）** |
| **`A1-W - New.igr`** | 841 × 594 | 1 | **无（101 个图元）** |

两份 `-W - New` 模板各被一张图选中：

- `A0-W - New.igr` ← `A井场 注采阀组工艺及自控流程图.pid`（幅面 1189.31 × 841.31，归档里的模板 1189.00 × 841.00）
- `A1-W - New.igr` ← `集注站 凝析油稳定塔、泵及换热器(600td)工艺及自控流程图.pid`（842.54 × 595.54 → 841.00 × 594.00）

它们和同名幅面的 `CPE-SQ` 兄弟**外接框一模一样**（1189 × 841 / 841 × 594），所以选模板的最后一键——磁盘上的文件名——才决定谁赢；仓库语料里没有这两份文件，备份包里有，于是同一张图在两种语料下穿不同模板。这就是之前闸门在备份包配置下撞红的原因，不是模板本身错了。

## 改动

[export_plant_backup.rs](pid-plot/tests/export_plant_backup.rs#L129-L148) 的 `TEMPLATE_PLACEMENTS` 从 5 行扩到 7 行，新增 `("A0-W - New.igr", &[])` 和 `("A1-W - New.igr", &[])`，并在常量的文档注释里写明：这两份只在外接框打平时靠文件名取胜、不落任何符号、pin 成两行是为了让闸门在两种语料下都成立。这是唯一改动的文件。

| 检查 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p pid-plot --test export_plant_backup`，`PID_TEST_DATA_DIR` 指向备份包 | ok，86.29 s |
| 同上，不设环境变量（仓库语料 + 两处 `pid-test-data`） | ok，93.00 s |
| `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` | 0 warning |
| `cargo fmt --all -- --check` | 干净 |

两种配置都是在最终文件上跑的（先跑备份包语料，再跑默认语料，中间只把注释里的 "six" 改成 "seven"；改完重跑了两边 + clippy + fmt）。没跑整套 workspace 测试：这次只动了一个测试常量和它的注释，而该测试已在两种语料下各通过一次。

一个仍未覆盖的口子：pin 断言的是"这份模板放这几个符号"，不含图元数量（105 / 101），所以模板若在标题栏家具上多画或少画，闸门不会响。要不要把这两个数也钉进去，是下一步可以考虑的收紧。

{"kind":"tool","id":"e_w7SSbEPeM","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"pid-plot/examples/tmp_template_extent.rs","content":"//! Scratch: what each template's furniture actually covers on the page.

use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use pid_plot::model::{PaperShape, lay_out_drawing};

fn collect_pids(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
        return;
    };
    let mut paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.filter_map(Result::ok).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
    paths.sort();
    for path in paths {
        if path.is_dir() {
            collect_pids(&path, out);
        } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "pid") {
            out.push(path);
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
    let backup = args.next().expect("backup dir");
    let corpus = args.next().expect("corpus dir");
    let backup = PathBuf::from(backup);
    let corpus = PathBuf::from(corpus);

    let mut drawings = Vec::new();
    collect_pids(&backup, &mut drawings);
    for path in &drawings {
        let Ok(model) = lay_out_drawing(path, &corpus) else {
            continue;
        };
        let Some(template) = model.template.as_ref() else {
            continue;
        };
        let mut min = [f64::INFINITY; 2];
        let mut max = [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 2];
        let mut take = |point: [f64; 2]| {
            for axis in 0..2 {
                min[axis] = min[axis].min(point[axis]);
                max[axis] = max[axis].max(point[axis]);
            }
        };
        for primitive in model.primitives.iter().filter(|p| p.furniture) {
            match &primitive.shape {
                PaperShape::Line { start_mm, end_mm } => {
                    take(*start_mm);
                    take(*end_mm);
                }
                PaperShape::Polyline { points_mm, .. } | PaperShape::Fill { chain_mm: points_mm, .. } => {
                    for point in points_mm {
                        take(*point);
                    }
                }
                PaperShape::Arc {
                    center_mm,
                    radius_mm,
                    ..
                }
                | PaperShape::Circle {
                    center_mm,
                    radius_mm,
                } => {
                    take([center_mm[0] - radius_mm, center_mm[1] - radius_mm]);
                    take([center_mm[0] + radius_mm, center_mm[1] + radius_mm]);
                }
                PaperShape::Text { .. } => {}
            }
        }
        let leaf = template
            .path
            .rsplit(['\\', '/'])
            .next()
            .unwrap_or(&template.path);
        println!(
            "{leaf:22} extent {:8.3} x {:8.3}  ink [{:8.3},{:8.3}]..[{:8.3},{:8.3}]  page {:?}  {}",
            template.extent_mm[0],
            template.extent_mm[1],
            min[0],
            min[1],
            max[0],
            max[1],
            model.page_mm,
            path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy()
        );
    }
}

[export_plant_backup.rs](pid-plot/tests/export_plant_backup.rs#L99-L171) 的 `TEMPLATE_PLACEMENTS` 元组从 `(文件名, 图元数, 放置)` 扩成 `(文件名, 外接框, 图元数, 放置)`：

| 模板 | 外接框 mm | 图元 |
|---|---|---:|
| `CPE-SQ-A0.igr` | 1189.000 × 841.000 | 175 |
| `CPE-SQ-A1.igr` | 841.000 × 594.000 | 175 |
| `CPE-SQ-A2.igr` | 594.000 × 420.000 | 175 |
| `CPECCHB-SQ-A1.igr` | 841.000 × 594.000 | 96 |
| `CPECCHB-SQ-A2.igr` | **593.939** × 420.000 | 116 |
| `A0-W - New.igr` | 1189.000 × 841.000 | 105 |
| `A1-W - New.igr` | 841.000 × 594.000 | 101 |

容差 0.02 mm——比模型挑选模板时使用的 2 mm 宽容差紧 100 倍。

实测还纠正了一处容易弄错的地方：外接框属于模板自身，不是图幅大小。`CPECCHB-SQ-A2` 被绘制成 593.939 mm 宽，而图纸是 594.33 mm；`A1-W - New.igr` 是 841 × 594，那幅 600td 的图纸是 842.54 × 595.54。如果直接固定图幅尺寸，就等于固定了错误数值。

但只固定 `extent_mm` 还不够：它只表示宽高，不含原点，模板内部整体平移时它不会变化，所以我在 pin 的注释中写明了这一点，并补上第二条断言——用页面上带 `furniture` 标记的笔画量出外接框，要求它从 `(0,0)` 延伸到 `extent_mm` 的尺寸（误差 0.02 mm）。模板按 1:1 从页面原点铺开，所以平移会使起点偏离原点，缩放会使终点偏离外接框。

+//! Scratch: what each template's furniture actually covers on the page.
+
+use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
+
+use pid_plot::model::{PaperShape, lay_out_drawing};
+
+fn collect_pids(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) {
+    let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir) else {
+        return;
+    };
+    let mut paths: Vec<PathBuf> = entries.filter_map(Result::ok).map(|e| e.path()).collect();
+    paths.sort();
+    for path in paths {
+        if path.is_dir() {
+            collect_pids(&path, out);
+        } else if path.extension().is_some_and(|extension| extension == "pid") {
+            out.push(path);
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+fn main() {
+    let mut args = std::env::args().skip(1);
+    let backup = args.next().expect("backup dir");
+    let corpus = args.next().expect("corpus dir");
+    let backup = PathBuf::from(backup);
+    let corpus = PathBuf::from(corpus);
+
+    let mut drawings = Vec::new();
+    collect_pids(&backup, &mut drawings);
+    for path in &drawings {
+        let Ok(model) = lay_out_drawing(path, &corpus) else {
+            continue;
+        };
+        let Some(template) = model.template.as_ref() else {
+            continue;
+        };
+        let mut min = [f64::INFINITY; 2];
+        let mut max = [f64::NEG_INFINITY; 2];
+        let mut take = |point: [f64; 2]| {
+            for axis in 0..2 {
+                min[axis] = min[axis].min(point[axis]);
+                max[axis] = max[axis].max(point[axis]);
+            }
+        };
+        for primitive in model.primitives.iter().filter(|p| p.furniture) {
+            match &primitive.shape {
+                PaperShape::Line { start_mm, end_mm } => {
+                    take(*start_mm);
+                    take(*end_mm);
+                }
+                PaperShape::Polyline { points_mm, .. } | PaperShape::Fill { chain_mm: points_mm, .. } => {
+                    for point in points_mm {
+                        take(*point);
+                    }
+                }
+                PaperShape::Arc {
+                    center_mm,
+                    radius_mm,
+                    ..
+                }
+                | PaperShape::Circle {
+                    center_mm,
+                    radius_mm,
+                } => {
+                    take([center_mm[0] - radius_mm, center_mm[1] - radius_mm]);
+                    take([center_mm[0] + radius_mm, center_mm[1] + radius_mm]);
+                }
+                PaperShape::Text { .. } => {}
+            }
+        }
+        let leaf = template
+            .path
+            .rsplit(['\\', '/'])
+            .next()
+            .unwrap_or(&template.path);
+        println!(
+            "{leaf:22} extent {:8.3} x {:8.3}  ink [{:8.3},{:8.3}]..[{:8.3},{:8.3}]  page {:?}  {}",
+            template.extent_mm[0],
+            template.extent_mm[1],
+            min[0],
+            min[1],
+            max[0],
+            max[1],
+            model.page_mm,
+            path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy()
+        );
+    }
+}

feat(refdata): read a backup's .igr and .sym straight from its RefData zips
The round that answered "which A2 templates do the sheets want" ended with
a manual step: unzip RefData~4~682.zip into Ref/Template Files, then plot.
A backup package keeps its reference data as archives beside Export.dmp,
never as an exploded Ref/ tree, so a package directory offered the layout
neither a template directory nor a symbol root -- and whatever step did
the unpacking decided what a page looked like. This reads the archives
instead, so that step is gone.

The reader is src/refdata_archive.rs behind a new `refdata-archive`
feature, which is the zip dependency alone: refdata_archives(dir) names
the RefData~*.zip a package keeps, archive_members(archive, "igr"|"sym")
lists what one holds from the central directory alone, and
read_archive_member inflates one member. backup-exp now enables dep:zip
through it, so the no-default-features and wasm32 gates still compile a
pid-parse without the reader, and pid-plot rides this feature by itself --
drawing a drawing links no publish pipeline, no rusqlite and not the
vendored GPL MDF parser.

Two traps, both in the names. Every entry name in these archives carries a
UTF-8 BOM, directories included (\u{feff}CPECCHBA2.igr), so file_name,
ends_with and file_stem matched nothing at all; member_name strips it,
unifies the separator and drops the trailing one. And a name may be GBK,
so members are walked by index and compared against that normalised name
rather than through ZipArchive::by_name, which decodes on its own and
refuses GBK. decode_zip_name moved out of backup::datamap to this module
so the two readers share one copy.

Symbols: an archive is a root. RefData~4~681.zip holds the same Design/,
Piping/, Equipment/ tree a symbol root does, so SymbolLibrary::with_archives
lists them after every directory root -- unpacking stays optional and
cannot change a page, which a unit test pins by carrying an unreadable
member where the directory has the real body. The by-name index takes
members too, so the authoring-machine temp path a title block stores still
resolves, and the "a name two roots carry is ambiguous" rule counts across
directories and archives alike. read_symbol_geometry_from_bytes is the
bytes entry point (PidPackage::from_bytes, no temp file); read_symbol_geometry
is now a shell over it.

Templates: a member is labelled <zip>\<member>, so the extent error, the
link-name prefix and file_stem all carry over unchanged -- the pick never
learns where a template came from. Directories are still listed first, for
the same reason as the symbols.

Readings, pid-plot/tests/refdata_archive_corpus.rs on the backup fixture
the repository already carries: DWG-0202GP06-01 wears the CPECCHBA2.igr it
names, out of ~682.zip, ink 594.00 x 420.00 with 101 primitives and the two
placements its title block makes from the file's own cache; D06 wears the
same one, reached through its CPECCH~2.IGR short name; with test-file as
the corpus those pages draw no furniture at all, which is what makes the
two readings the archive's doing; and with every directory root empty and
only ~681.zip given, a symbol body still resolves.

XIONGANA2.igr and that member is in the archive, but it reads as 6
entities -- 2 Other, 1 Symbol, 3 Text (核准 / 校对 / 储运工艺) -- with a
653-byte Sheet6 that declares a sheet and holds no geometry; its own

ACAD_GLOBALS.FileName = ...\xionganA2.dwg, so it is a .dwg carried through
