//! B drawing vertical x~578.78, full height, plus the horizontal rail.
//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_gap_train

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::read::read_plot;

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),
        PathBuf::from,
    )
}

fn main() {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let name = "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图";
    let reference_bytes = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{name}.pdf"))).expect("reference");
    let reference = read_plot(&reference_bytes).expect("read reference");
    // Vertical strokes at x~578.78, sorted bottom-up.
    let mut v: Vec<[f64; 2]> = reference
        .segments
        .iter()
        .filter(|s| {
            (s.start_mm[0] - 578.78).abs() < 0.2
                && (s.end_mm[0] - 578.78).abs() < 0.2
                && (s.start_mm[1] - s.end_mm[1]).abs() > 0.01
                && (s.width_mm - 0.169).abs() < 0.01
        })
        .map(|s| {
            let lo = s.start_mm[1].min(s.end_mm[1]);
            let hi = s.start_mm[1].max(s.end_mm[1]);
            [lo, hi]
        })
        .collect();
    v.sort_by(|a, b| a[0].partial_cmp(&b[0]).unwrap());
    println!("vertical run: {} strokes", v.len());
    let mut prev_hi: Option<f64> = None;
    for [lo, hi] in &v {
        let len = hi - lo;
        if let Some(p) = prev_hi {
            println!("   gap {:6.3}  ink {:5.3}  [{:.2},{:.2}]", lo - p, len, lo, hi);
        } else {
            println!("   ----  ink {:5.3}  [{:.2},{:.2}]", len, lo, hi);
        }
        prev_hi = Some(*hi);
    }
}
"}}

//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_gap_train

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::read::read_plot;

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),
        PathBuf::from,
    )
}

fn train(pdf: &str, x0: f64, x1: f64, y0: f64, y1: f64, w: f64, label: &str) {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let bytes = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{pdf}.pdf"))).expect("reference");
    let reference = read_plot(&bytes).expect("read reference");
    // Horizontal strokes at height ~y, sorted by x.
    let mut v: Vec<[f64; 2]> = reference
        .segments
        .iter()
        .filter(|s| {
            (s.start_mm[1] - s.end_mm[1]).abs() < 0.01
                && (s.start_mm[1] - (y0 + y1) / 2.0).abs() < 1.5
                && (s.width_mm - w).abs() < 0.01
        })
        .map(|s| {
            let lo = s.start_mm[0].min(s.end_mm[0]);
            let hi = s.start_mm[0].max(s.end_mm[0]);
            [lo, hi]
        })
        .collect();
    v.sort_by(|a, b| a[0].partial_cmp(&b[0]).unwrap());
    println!("{label}: {} strokes", v.len());
    // Collapse contiguous (gap 0) into ink chunks, print chunk + gap sequence.
    let mut chunks: Vec<[f64; 2]> = Vec::new();
    for [lo, hi] in &v {
        if let Some(last) = chunks.last_mut() {
            if lo - last[1] < 0.01 {
                last[1] = last[1].max(*hi);
                continue;
            }
        }
        chunks.push([*lo, *hi]);
    }
    let mut prev_hi: Option<f64> = None;
    for [lo, hi] in &chunks {
        if *lo < x0 || *lo > x1 {
            prev_hi = Some(*hi);
            continue;
        }
        if let Some(p) = prev_hi {
            println!("   gap {:6.3}  ink {:5.3}  [{:.2},{:.2}]", lo - p, hi - lo, lo, hi);
        } else {
            println!("   ----  ink {:5.3}  [{:.2},{:.2}]", hi - lo, lo, hi);
        }
        prev_hi = Some(*hi);
    }
    let _ = (y0, y1);
}

fn main() {
    // B rail: y=357.80, x 478-579.
    train(
        "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图",
        505.0,
        579.0,
        357.8,
        357.8,
        0.169,
        "B horizontal rail y=357.8",
    );
}
"}}

+//! Gap trains along reference dashed routes: B horizontal rail + I long rail.
+//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_gap_train
+
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use pid_plot::read::read_plot;
+
+fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
+    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
+        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),
+        PathBuf::from,
+    )
+}
+
+fn train(pdf: &str, x0: f64, x1: f64, y0: f64, y1: f64, w: f64, label: &str) {
+    let corpus = corpus_dir();
+    let bytes = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{pdf}.pdf"))).expect("reference");
+    let reference = read_plot(&bytes).expect("read reference");
+    // Horizontal strokes at height ~y, sorted by x.
+    let mut v: Vec<[f64; 2]> = reference
+        .segments
+        .iter()
+        .filter(|s| {
+            (s.start_mm[1] - s.end_mm[1]).abs() < 0.01
+                && (s.start_mm[1] - (y0 + y1) / 2.0).abs() < 1.5
+                && (s.width_mm - w).abs() < 0.01
+        })
+        .map(|s| {
+            let lo = s.start_mm[0].min(s.end_mm[0]);
+            let hi = s.start_mm[0].max(s.end_mm[0]);
+            [lo, hi]
+        })
+        .collect();
+    v.sort_by(|a, b| a[0].partial_cmp(&b[0]).unwrap());
+    println!("{label}: {} strokes", v.len());
+    // Collapse contiguous (gap 0) into ink chunks, print chunk + gap sequence.
+    let mut chunks: Vec<[f64; 2]> = Vec::new();
+    for [lo, hi] in &v {
+        if let Some(last) = chunks.last_mut() {
+            if lo - last[1] < 0.01 {
+                last[1] = last[1].max(*hi);
+                continue;
+            }
+        }
+        chunks.push([*lo, *hi]);
+    }
+    let mut prev_hi: Option<f64> = None;
+    for [lo, hi] in &chunks {
+        if *lo < x0 || *lo > x1 {
+            prev_hi = Some(*hi);
+            continue;
+        }
+        if let Some(p) = prev_hi {
+            println!("   gap {:6.3}  ink {:5.3}  [{:.2},{:.2}]", lo - p, hi - lo, lo, hi);
+        } else {
+            println!("   ----  ink {:5.3}  [{:.2},{:.2}]", hi - lo, lo, hi);
+        }
+        prev_hi = Some(*hi);
+    }
+    let _ = (y0, y1);
+}
+
+fn main() {
+    // B rail: y=357.80, x 478-579.
+    train(
+        "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图",
+        505.0,
+        579.0,
+        357.8,
+        357.8,
+        0.169,
+        "B horizontal rail y=357.8",
+    );
+}

+//! Dump every distinct dash array the reference plots use, with counts.
+//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_ref_dash_arrays
+
+use std::collections::BTreeMap;
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use hayro::hayro_interpret::hayro_syntax::Pdf;
+use hayro::hayro_interpret::{
+    BlendMode, ClipPath, Context, Device, GlyphDrawMode, Image, InterpreterCache,
+    InterpreterSettings, Paint, PathDrawMode, SoftMask, TransformExt, interpret_page,
+};
+use hayro::hayro_interpret::font::Glyph;
+use kurbo::{Affine, Rect};
+
+fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
+    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
+        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),
+        PathBuf::from,
+    )
+}
+
+struct DashDevice {
+    dashes: BTreeMap<String, usize>,
+}
+
+impl Device<'_> for DashDevice {
+    fn set_soft_mask(&mut self, _: Option<SoftMask<'_>>) {}
+    fn set_blend_mode(&mut self, _: BlendMode) {}
+    fn push_clip_path(&mut self, _: &ClipPath) {}
+    fn pop_clip_path(&mut self) {}
+    fn push_transparency_group(&mut self, _: f32, _: Option<SoftMask<'_>>, _: BlendMode) {}
+    fn pop_transparency_group(&mut self) {}
+    fn draw_image(&mut self, _: Image<'_, '_>, _: Affine) {}
+    fn draw_rect(
+        &mut self,
+        _: &Rect,
+        _: Affine,
+        _: &Paint<'_>,
+        _: &PathDrawMode,
+    ) {
+    }
+    fn draw_path(
+        &mut self,
+        _: &kurbo::BezPath,
+        _: Affine,
+        _: &Paint<'_>,
+        draw_mode: &PathDrawMode,
+    ) {
+        if let PathDrawMode::Stroke(stroke) = draw_mode {
+            let key = format!(
+                "w={:.4} dash=[{}] off={:.4}",
+                f64::from(stroke.line_width),
+                stroke
+                    .dash_array
+                    .iter()
+                    .map(|v| format!("{:.4}", f64::from(*v)))
+                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+                    .join(" "),
+                f64::from(stroke.dash_offset),
+            );
+            *self.dashes.entry(key).or_default() += 1;
+        }
+    }
+    fn draw_glyph(
+        &mut self,
+        _: &Glyph<'_>,
+        _: Affine,
+        _: Affine,
+        _: &Paint<'_>,
+        _: &GlyphDrawMode,
+    ) {
+    }
+}
+
+fn main() {
+    let corpus = corpus_dir();
+    for name in [
+        "I井场 注采阀组工艺及自控流程图",
+        "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器A工艺及自控流程图",
+    ] {
+        let bytes = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{name}.pdf"))).expect("reference");
+        let pdf = Pdf::new(bytes).expect("pdf");
+        let pages = pdf.pages();
+        let page = &pages[0];
+        let (w, h) = page.render_dimensions();
+        let cache = InterpreterCache::new();
+        let settings = InterpreterSettings {
+            render_annotations: false,
+            ..Default::default()
+        };
+        let initial = page.initial_transform(true).to_kurbo();
+        let mut ctx = Context::new(
+            initial,
+            Rect::new(0.0, 0.0, f64::from(w), f64::from(h)),
+            &cache,
+            page.xref(),
+            settings,
+        );
+        let mut device = DashDevice {
+            dashes: BTreeMap::new(),
+        };
+        interpret_page(page, &mut ctx, &mut device);
+        println!("== {name} (pt units)");
+        for (key, count) in &device.dashes {
+            println!("   {count:>6}  {key}");
+        }
+    }
+}

+//! Full point list of the long dashed route polyline(s) on B.
+//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_route_points
+
+use std::path::PathBuf;
+
+use pid_plot::model::{PaperShape, lay_out_drawing};
+
+fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
+    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR").map_or_else(
+        || PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"),

+fn main() {

+    let model = lay_out_drawing(&corpus.join(format!("{name}.pid")), &corpus).expect("layout");
+    for p in &model.primitives {
+        let dash = p
+            .stroke
+            .as_ref()
+            .map(|s| {
+                s.dash_mm
+                    .iter()
+                    .map(|v| format!("{v:.4}"))
+                    .collect::<Vec<_>>()
+                    .join("/")
+            })
+            .unwrap_or_default();
+        if dash.is_empty() {
+            continue;
+        }
+        if let PaperShape::Polyline { points_mm, .. } = &p.shape {
+            // Only the long ones crossing x~578.8.
+            let crosses = points_mm.windows(2).any(|w| {
+                let x0 = w[0][0].min(w[1][0]);
+                let x1 = w[0][0].max(w[1][0]);
+                x0 < 579.0 && x1 > 578.6
+            });
+            if !crosses {
+                continue;
+            }
+            println!("dashed polyline, {} points, dash [{}]:", points_mm.len(), dash);
+            for q in points_mm {
+                println!("   ({:.3},{:.3})", q[0], q[1]);
+            }
+        }
+    }
+}

{"kind":"tool","id":"jGJ8WdYPams","toolName":"write_file","input":{"path":"pid-plot/examples/tmp_rail_styles.rs","instructions":"Probe which model primitives sit on the B rail","content":"//! Which model primitives sit on the B rail (y~357.8, x 505-579)?
//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_rail_styles

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::model::{PaperShape, lay_out_drawing};

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR")
        .map_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"), PathBuf::from)
}

fn main() {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let name = "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图";
    let model = lay_out_drawing(&corpus.join(format!("{name}.pid")), &corpus).expect("layout");
    let mut rows: Vec<(f64, String)> = Vec::new();
    for p in &model.primitives {
        let (y, x0, x1, kind) = match &p.shape {
            PaperShape::Line { start_mm, end_mm } => {
                if (start_mm[1] - end_mm[1]).abs() > 0.05 {
                    continue;
                }
                (start_mm[1], start_mm[0].min(end_mm[0]), start_mm[0].max(end_mm[0]), "line")
            }
            PaperShape::Polyline { points_mm, .. } => {
                if points_mm.len() != 2 {
                    continue;
                }
                let (a, b) = (points_mm[0], points_mm[1]);
                if (a[1] - b[1]).abs() > 0.05 {
                    continue;
                }
                (a[1], a[0].min(b[0]), a[0].max(b[0]), "pl")
            }
            _ => continue,
        };
        if (y - 357.8).abs() > 1.5 {
            continue;
        }
        if x1 < 500.0 || x0 > 580.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let (w, dash) = p
            .stroke
            .as_ref()
            .map(|s| {
                (
                    s.width_mm,
                    s.dash_mm
                        .iter()
                        .map(|v| format!("{v:.3}"))
                        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
                        .join("/"),
                )
            })
            .unwrap_or((-1.0, "none".into()));
        rows.push((
            x0,
            format!(
                "{kind} x[{x0:.2},{x1:.2}] y={y:.3} w={w:.3} dash=[{dash}] conf={} sym={:?} path={:?} oid={:?}",
                p.confidence, p.symbol, p.stream_path, p.graphic_oid,
            ),
        ));
    }
    rows.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.partial_cmp(&b.0).unwrap());
    println!("B rail primitives: {}", rows.len());
    for (_, r) in rows {
        println!("  {r}");
    }
}
"}}

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::model::{PaperShape, lay_out_drawing};

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {

        .map_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"), PathBuf::from)
}

fn pts_of(shape: &PaperShape) -> Vec<[f64; 2]> {
    match shape {
        PaperShape::Line { start_mm, end_mm } => vec![*start_mm, *end_mm],
        PaperShape::Polyline { points_mm, .. } => points_mm.clone(),
        PaperShape::Arc { .. } => vec![],
        PaperShape::Circle { .. } => vec![],
        PaperShape::Fill { .. } => vec![],
        PaperShape::Text { .. } => vec![],
    }
}

fn main() {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let name = "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图";
    let model = lay_out_drawing(&corpus.join(format!("{name}.pid")), &corpus).expect("layout");
    let mut n = 0;
    for p in &model.primitives {
        let pts = pts_of(&p.shape);
        if pts.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let (mut ax, mut bx, mut ay, mut by) =
            (f64::INFINITY, f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::INFINITY, f64::NEG_INFINITY);

            ax = ax.min(q[0]);
            bx = bx.max(q[0]);

            pts.len(),
            p.confidence,
            p.symbol,
            p.byte_range,
        );
    }
    println!("touching: {n}");
}

//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_dash_sweep

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::read::read_plot;

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR")
        .map_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"), PathBuf::from)
}

fn stats(label: &str, pdf: &str, width: f64) {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let bytes = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{pdf}.pdf"))).expect("ref");
    let reference = read_plot(&bytes).expect("read");
    // long straight runs: group colinear overlapping-x segments by rounded y
    use std::collections::BTreeMap;
    let mut rows: BTreeMap<i32, Vec<[f64; 2]>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for s in &reference.segments {
        if (s.width_mm - width).abs() > 0.02 {
            continue;
        }
        if (s.start_mm[1] - s.end_mm[1]).abs() > 0.05 {
            continue;
        }
        let ykey = (s.start_mm[1] * 2.0).round() as i32;
        let lo = s.start_mm[0].min(s.end_mm[0]);
        let hi = s.start_mm[0].max(s.end_mm[0]);
        rows.entry(ykey).or_default().push([lo, hi]);
    }
    // pick the longest row with >=8 pieces
    let mut best: Vec<[f64; 2]> = vec![];
    for (_, mut v) in rows {
        v.sort_by(|a, b| a[0].partial_cmp(&b[0]).unwrap());
        let span = v.last().unwrap()[1] - v[0][0];
        if v.len() >= 8 && span > best.iter().map(|[l, h]| h - l).sum::<f64>() {
            best = v;
        }
    }
    if best.is_empty() {
        println!("{label}: no run");
        return;
    }
    let mains: Vec<f64> = best.iter().map(|[l, h]| h - l).filter(|l| *l >= 0.5).collect();
    let slivers = best.iter().filter(|[l, h]| h - l < 0.5).count();
    let mut gaps = vec![];
    for i in 1..best.len() {
        let g = best[i][0] - best[i - 1][1];
        if g > 0.05 {
            gaps.push(g);
        }
    }
    let avg = |v: &[f64]| v.iter().sum::<f64>() / v.len() as f64;
    println!(
        "{label}: n={} mains_avg={:.3} ({:.2}px) gaps_avg={:.3} ({:.2}px) slivers={}",
        best.len(),
        avg(&mains),
        avg(&mains) / 0.16933,
        avg(&gaps),
        avg(&gaps) / 0.16933,
        slivers
    );
}

fn main() {
    stats(
        "B rail w0.169",
        "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图",

}

                let la = (ax * ax + ay * ay).sqrt();
                let lb = (bx * bx + by * by).sqrt();

        _: Affine,
        _: &Paint<'_>,
        draw_mode: &PathDrawMode,

    }

//! Run: cargo run -q -p pid-plot --example tmp_rail_styles

use std::path::PathBuf;

use pid_plot::model::{PaperShape, lay_out_drawing};
use pid_plot::read::{DashWalk, read_plot};

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR")
        .map_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"), PathBuf::from)
}

fn main() {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    let name = "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图";
    let bytes = std::fs::read(corpus.join(format!("{name}.pdf"))).expect("reference");
    let reference = read_plot(&bytes).expect("read reference");
    // Vertical strokes crossing y=357.835.
    let mut v: Vec<[f64; 2]> = reference
        .segments
        .iter()
        .filter(|s| {
            (s.start_mm[0] - s.end_mm[0]).abs() < 0.01
                && (s.width_mm - 0.169).abs() < 0.02
                && s.start_mm[1].min(s.end_mm[1]) < 357.835
                && s.start_mm[1].max(s.end_mm[1]) > 357.835
        })
        .map(|s| [s.start_mm[1].min(s.end_mm[1]), s.start_mm[1].max(s.end_mm[1])])
        .collect();
    v.sort_by(|a, b| a[0].partial_cmp(&b[0]).unwrap());
    println!("vertical 0.169 strokes crossing y=357.835: {}", v.len());
    // Group by x (same crossing line split into pieces shares x).
    let mut by_x: Vec<(f64, Vec<[f64; 2]>)> = Vec::new();
    for seg in reference.segments.iter().filter(|s| {
        (s.start_mm[0] - s.end_mm[0]).abs() < 0.01 && (s.width_mm - 0.169).abs() < 0.02
    }) {
        let x = seg.start_mm[0];
        if x < 470.0 || x > 585.0 {
            continue;
        }
        let y0 = seg.start_mm[1].min(seg.end_mm[1]);
        let y1 = seg.start_mm[1].max(seg.end_mm[1]);
        if y0 < 357.835 && y1 > 357.835 {
            match by_x.last_mut() {
                Some(last) if (last.0 - x).abs() < 0.01 => last.1.push([y0, y1]),
                _ => by_x.push((x, vec![[y0, y1]])),
            }
        }
    }
    for (x, spans) in &by_x {
        let lo: f64 = spans.iter().map(|s| s[0]).fold(f64::INFINITY, f64::min);
        let hi: f64 = spans.iter().map(|s| s[1]).fold(f64::NEG_INFINITY, f64::max);
        println!("   tap x={x:.3} spans={} y=[{lo:.2},{hi:.2}]", spans.len());
    }
    // Our model's own pieces for the rail polyline.
    let model = lay_out_drawing(&corpus.join(format!("{name}.pid")), &corpus).expect("layout");
    for p in &model.primitives {
        if let PaperShape::Polyline { points_mm, .. } = &p.shape {
            let crosses = points_mm.windows(2).any(|w| {
                let x0 = w[0][0].min(w[1][0]);
                let x1 = w[0][0].max(w[1][0]);
                x0 < 579.0 && x1 > 578.6
            });
            if !crosses {
                continue;
            }
            let dash = p.stroke.as_ref().map(|s| s.dash_mm.clone()).unwrap_or_default();
            println!("our rail: {} pts dash={dash:.4?}", points_mm.len());
            let mut walk = DashWalk::new(&dash, 0.0);
            for pair in points_mm.windows(2) {
                for (a, b) in walk.split(pair[0], pair[1]) {
                    if b[0] > 505.0 && a[0] < 516.0 && (a[1] - 357.835).abs() < 0.01 {
                        println!("   ours [{:.3},{:.3}]", a[0], b[0]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

//! Run: cargo run -q --example tmp_corpus_dash

use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::io::Read;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

use cfb::CompoundFile;

fn corpus_dir() -> PathBuf {
    std::env::var_os("PID_PARSE_SELF_CHECK_DIR")
        .map_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(r"D:\work\cad\PID自研软件验证"), PathBuf::from)
}

fn u16_at(d: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<u16> {
    let s = d.get(at..at + 2)?;
    Some(u16::from_le_bytes([s[0], s[1]]))
}
fn u32_at(d: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<u32> {
    let s = d.get(at..at + 4)?;
    Some(u32::from_le_bytes([s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3]]))
}
fn f64_at(d: &[u8], at: usize) -> Option<f64> {
    let s = d.get(at..at + 8)?;
    Some(f64::from_le_bytes([
        s[0], s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], s[5], s[6], s[7],
    ]))
}

fn payloads_of(data: &[u8], want: u16) -> Vec<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let mut at = 8;
    while at + 6 <= data.len() {
        let (Some(t), Some(btf)) = (u16_at(data, at), u32_at(data, at + 2)) else {
            break;
        };
        let end = at + 6 + btf as usize;
        if t & 0x3FFF == 0 || btf == 0 || end > data.len() {
            break;
        }
        if t & 0x3FFF == want {
            out.push(data[at + 6..end].to_vec());
        }
        at = end;
    }
    out
}

fn main() {
    let corpus = corpus_dir();
    for name in [
        "I井场 注采阀组工艺及自控流程图",
        "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器A工艺及自控流程图",
        "集注站 凝析油闪蒸单元 一级闪蒸分离器B工艺及自控流程图",
        "集注站 烃水露点控制单元（一） 低温分离器A工艺及自控流程图",
        "集注站 烃水露点控制单元（二） 换热器CD及外输阀组工艺及自控流程图",
    ] {
        let path = corpus.join(format!("{name}.pid"));
        let Ok(file) = std::fs::File::open(&path) else {
            println!("{name}: no pid");
            continue;
        };
        let Ok(mut cfb) = CompoundFile::open(file) else {
            println!("{name}: no cfb");
            continue;
        };
        let names: Vec<String> = cfb
            .walk()
            .filter(cfb::Entry::is_stream)
            .map(|e| e.path().to_string_lossy().into_owned())
            .collect();
        println!("== {name} ==");
        let mut table: BTreeMap<(u32, String), usize> = BTreeMap::new();
        for stream_name in &names {
            let Ok(mut stream) = cfb.open_stream(stream_name.as_str()) else {
                continue;
            };
            let mut data = Vec::new();
            if stream.read_to_end(&mut data).is_err() {
                continue;
            }
            for p in payloads_of(&data, 0x002F) {
                let id = u32_at(&p, 14).unwrap_or(0);
                let n = u16_at(&p, 48).unwrap_or(0);
                let fits = p.len() == 50 + 8 * n as usize;
                let vals: Vec<String> = (0..n as usize)
                    .filter_map(|i| f64_at(&p, 50 + 8 * i))
                    .map(|v| format!("{:+.3}", v * 1000.0))
                    .collect();
                let key = (
                    id,
                    format!("N={n} fits={fits} [{}] {}", vals.join(", "), stream_name),
                );
                *table.entry(key).or_default() += 1;
            }
            let _ = Path::new("");
        }
        for ((id, desc), count) in &table {
            println!("   id={id:<5} x{count}  {desc}");
        }
    }
}
"}}

                    start_mm[1].min(end_mm[1]),
                    start_mm[0].max(end_mm[0]),
                    start_mm[1].max(end_mm[1]),

                for q in points_mm {
                    x0 = x0.min(q[0]);
                    y0 = y0.min(q[1]);
                    x1 = x1.max(q[0]);
                    y1 = y1.max(q[1]);

                    center_mm[1] - radius_mm,
                    center_mm[0] + radius_mm,
                    center_mm[1] + radius_mm,

                    center_mm[1] - radius_mm,
                    center_mm[0] + radius_mm,
                    center_mm[1] + radius_mm,
                ]),
            ),
